notes.title: Update 4.1: Bug Fixes and Improvements
notes.content: [p]Subjects,[/p][p align="justify"]Today’s update delivers a fresh wave of improvements and bug fixes shaped directly by your feedback on our newest map, [b][i]Helios[/i][/b] and beyond.[/p][p align="justify"]We’ve addressed some of the higher priority issues raised since release, but we have also taken some time to work on some of the most upvoted suggestions from our Feedback Forums on Discord. [/p][p align="justify"]Your input continues to make the game better, so thank you for sharing your thoughts and helping us fine-tune the experience.[/p][p]See you in the next Ritual. [/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][p align="justify"][b]Improvements [/b][/p][list][*][p align="justify"]Introduced improved 3D spatial audio (HRTF) for headphones on all platforms (must be enabled in your game settings).[/p][/*][*][p align="justify"]Watering can water impact sound now comes from the impact point.[/p][/*][*][p align="justify"]Implemented voting sounds for the Helios map’s Voting Table.[/p][/*][*][p align="justify"]Globe Weak Point changes colour to red when activated.[/p][/*][*][p align="justify"]Menace no longer switches to the Third person on the Space Walk sabotage.[/p][/*][*][p align="justify"]Voting table models now rotate.[/p][/*][*][p align="justify"]Sabotage alert on Space map now has two waypoints to make it easier to navigate to it.[/p][/*][*][p align="justify"]Banana placement on Space map for Monkey.[/p][/*][*][p align="justify"]Added shake to Earthquake mutation.[/p][/*][*][p align="justify"]Added a debuff visual for Earthquake mutation.[/p][/*][*][p]Terror grab will prioritize players over destructible objects.[/p][/*][/list][p align="justify"][b]Fixes[/b][/p][list][*][p align="justify"]\[FIXED] Earthquake mutation affecting everyone regardless of distance and whether they are in terror form or not.[/p][/*][*][p align="justify"]\[FIXED] Not being able to hear people at night on a Space map.[/p][/*][*][p align="justify"]\[FIXED] Menace losing its Menace form after entering Space Walk.[/p][/*][*][p align="justify"]\[FIXED] Monkey Balloons and Asteroids tasks don't show progress.[/p][/*][*][p align="justify"]\[FIXED] Occasionally not being able to escape as the door opens on the lowest Space map floor.[/p][/*][*][p align="justify"]\[FIXED] Phantom occasionally not respawning as Menace after voting table vote.[/p][/*][*][p align="justify"]\[FIXED] Occasionally getting stuck in Antigravity tubes.[/p][/*][*][p align="justify"]\[FIXED] Being able to move buttons on sabotage repair before the code is shown.[/p][/*][*][p align="justify"]\[FIXED] Terror incoming sound in Antigravity tubes being duplicated.[/p][/*][*][p align="justify"]\[FIXED] Occasionally not seeing vote progress bar on holograms.[/p][/*][*][p align="justify"]\[FIXED] Selfie emote moving the player.[/p][/*][*][p align="justify"]\[FIXED] 2D sounds were playing on the meteor blaster task to all players.[/p][/*][*][p align="justify"]\[FIXED] Observer gaining sanity from tasks.[/p][/*][*][p align="justify"]\[FIXED] Legacy looks grey-ish since the FPS update.[/p][/*][*][p align="justify"]\[FIXED] Asteroid task not playing audio.[/p][/*][*][p align="justify"]\[FIXED] Uneven Floor Collisions on the Space Map Bridge. [/p][/*][*][p align="justify"]\[FIXED] Knuckle Head accolade increasing in the Standard game.[/p][/*][*][p align="justify"]\[FIXED] Inquisitor icon is now correct in the glossary.[/p][/*][*][p align="justify"]\[FIXED] Terror grab not grabbing players when next to wall crack.[/p][/*][*][p]\[FIXED] Issue with continuing to talk through Tannoy after switching transmission modes back and forth.[/p][/*][*][p]\[FIXED] Moonwalk Emote now animates in place and does not move.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Season 4: Astral Reckoning & New Ritual Site
notes.content:
[h1][b]Season 4: Astral Reckoning & New Ritual Site[/b][/h1][p][/p][p align="justify"]Welcome to Season 4: [i]Astral Reckoning[/i]. A season of creeping cosmic dread begins, starting with a new map and our space-themed Season Pass.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]New Ritual Site: The Helios Program[/b][/h3][p][/p][h3][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43698514/026f21b8c0b1aad82342021fb24c225268cc5092.gif"][/img][b]
[/b][/h3][p align="justify"]When it launched, the Helios Program was humanity’s proudest moment: the first manned interstellar vessel, proof that we could go further when united. For five years it ventured out into the dark, sending back steady reports from beyond the Solar System.
[/p][p align="justify"]Then the signals stopped.
[/p][p align="justify"]Four months of silence passed before Helios spoke again. But the transmissions were not the same. No charts. No data. No mention of the mission. Instead, the voices seemed intent on conversation. Small talk, questions, laughter that came just a little too late. They wanted someone, anyone, to stay on the line.
[/p][p align="justify"]The longer they spoke, the stranger it felt. Questions repeated word for word. Familiar voices began to blur, as if rehearsed. Beneath the chatter was a raw, aching need that unsettled every listener. It was still the crew of Helios - at least, that’s what the voices insisted.
[/p][p align="justify"]But what came back from the void no longer sounded like explorers reporting home.  It sounded like something very lonely, learning how to keep us talking.[/p][p align="justify"]Somewhere in these immaculate halls, danger moves unseen and the void beyond the hull is never far away…[/p][p align="justify"]Step into the Ritual’s first multi-level spacecraft: three floors that will test your wits, coordination, and nerve like never before.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Airlock Sabotage[/b][/h3][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]The Infected can break the seal on the ship’s airlocks, forcing the crew into a perilous repair mission. Don a spacesuit and step through the airlock - the only thing between you and the infinite dark: then embark on a tense spacewalk to repair the seal.[/p][p align="justify"]To succeed, you must complete a memory puzzle for each of the three terminals: a sequence of keypad entries, each harder than the last. Fail a sequence and you’ll be set back, giving the Infected more time to hunt.[/p][p align="justify"][/p][h3][b]Inspection Protocol[/b][/h3][p]In the cafeteria lies a single, ominous Big Red Button. Pressing will call an emergency vote on the start of the next reality phase. This will summon holograms of every alive player around the main bar. Subjects are able to vote on others until the reality phase ends. [/p][p align="justify"]One subject with the highest vote is selected. The action will differ depending on how many votes the subject in question has received. A small number of votes will reveal their team, a larger number their role and finally, if the subject received a lot of votes they will be ejected from the space ship. In case of a tie, no action will be taken. [/p][p align="justify"]The results are announced the next reality phase.[/p][p align="justify"][i]*The Helios Program Map is free for all players.[/i][/p][p align="justify"][/p][hr][/hr][h1][b]Season 4: Astral Reckoning - September 4 to December 3[/b][/h1][p align="justify"][b]Our first three-month Season is here. [/b]With an extra page in the Season Pass, there’s more to strive for and more to prove for the most dedicated players.[/p][p align="justify"]Season Pass available now from the in-game store. [/p][p][/p][h3][b]Astronaut Skins[/b][/h3][p align="justify"]To celebrate the launch of the new map, we have one for every character. Who will you take into the void? [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43698514/286536a39828e5a7ba416f76b665e5cb3131a769.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3][b]Arcane Jak and Knuckle Duster[/b][/h3][p align="justify"]Two new Arcane skins have just arrived in the Arcane Store: Jak and Knuckle Duster.[/p][h3]
[b]Performance and Optimisation[/b][/h3][p]Behind the scenes we have been working on improving performance and optimisation. This update includes the long awaited [b]high performance mode for consoles[/b], and other improvements that will see an approximate increase[b] in FPS by 20% across all platforms[/b].[/p][p][/p][h1][b]Coming Mid-Season[/b][/h1][p align="justify"]Don’t get too comfortable. Something else is coming to stalk these pristine halls. A new Terror will soon darken the corridors. [/p][p align="justify"]Our next DLC: [b]The Alien Pack.[/b][/p][p align="justify"]Coming Mid-Season.  [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43698514/0b455c0c2f2b12fe117e9a6ab52f43f4cfddaf7a.gif"][/img][/p][h3][b]Patch Notes[/b][/h3][p align="justify"][b]Improvements[/b][/p][list][*][p align="justify"]Removed role description from the Q menu.[/p][/*][*][p]Updated Oxygen Draining effect. \[Legacy][/p][/*][/list][p align="justify"][b]Fixes[/b][/p][list][*][p align="justify"]\[FIXED] Explosive Experiment visuals.[/p][/*][*][p align="justify"]\[FIXED] Passive outlines intervening with ability outlines (e.g. Seer white character outline). The ability outlines now fill with passive outline colours.[/p][/*][*][p align="justify"]\[FIXED] Shield emote showing the wrong sticker.[/p][/*][*][p align="justify"]\[FIXED] Players appearing in their true form as Inbetween ends.[/p][/*][*][p align="justify"]\[FIXED] Various map exploits on Wurgen and Circus.[/p][/*][*][p align="justify"]\[FIXED] Teleport glitch on Circus.[/p][/*][*][p align="justify"]\[FIXED] Observer not progressing accolade.[/p][/*][*][p align="justify"]\[FIXED] Face twitching on role screen.[/p][/*][*][p align="justify"]\[FIXED] Camera flicker when opening the game.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Update 3.2: Arcane Skins and Bug Fixes
notes.content:
[p]Subjects,
[/p][p]Today brings Update 3.2. [/p][p]
Two new Arcane Skins have just arrived in the Arcane Store: [b]Nina[/b] and [b]Walkie Talkie[/b]. Stylish, eerie, and Ritual-ready.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43698514/5d2e23b623e04d603167acfaaf180be20eedbf3d.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]As development continues on the larger updates for [b]Season 4[/b], we’re asking for your input. As a small team, your feedback directly shapes what we focus on next and for the rest of 2025.[/p][p][/p][p]The launch of [b]Legacy Mode[/b] has been exciting, and we’re glad so many of you are enjoying it. That said, we know there’s still work to do. Based on your suggestions, we’ve put together a poll to help decide what improvements or features we prioritise next.[/p][p][/p][p]You’ll find the poll in Discord, head to [b]d2-feedback-polls[/b]. It will be open for one week. Jump in and vote, every response helps. We will be doing more of these polls in future, not just for Legacy Mode. [/p][p][/p][p]We’ll gather and share the results in the next update.[/p][p][/p][p]Until then, see you in the Ritual. [/p][p][/p][h2][b]Legacy Mode[/b][/h2][h3][b]Balance changes[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Removed trap explosion delay.[/p][/*][*][p]Respawn with 3 spare ammo.[/p][/*][*][p]Morgus Clone now has 100 HP and 100 Light Health. [/p][/*][*][p]When Morgus uses their ability, they now get 20% movement speed for a short duration.[/p][/*][*][p]Pistol reloads 30% faster.
[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Improvements[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Improved overall lighting.[/p][/*][*][p]Removed cabins from bathroom toilets.[/p][/*][*][p]Terror sounds are now more frequent.[/p][/*][*][p]Increased time to open Dual Objective, it cannot be obtained until it is fully open.[/p][/*][*][p]Removed visuals from the floor when a player dies or disconnects.[/p][/*][*][p]Made it easier to vote with Knuckle Dusters on downed players.[/p][/*][*][p]Can no longer interact with a door until it's fully opened/closed.[/p][/*][*][p]Created a new sound for Experiment Block Ability.[/p][/*][*][p]Moved Game Watch Popup to the top left.
[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Fixes[/b][/h3][list][*][p]\[FIXED] Being able to jump and see through some walls.[/p][/*][*][p]\[FIXED] Echo in Voice Chat.[/p][/*][*][p]\[FIXED] Being able to jump on doors.[/p][/*][*][p]\[FIXED] Being stuck in doors. Door will now stop if it is about to trap you.[/p][/*][*][p]\[FIXED] Terrors not dying to gas.[/p][/*][*][p]\[FIXED] Terrors not respawning when shot in gas.[/p][/*][*][p]\[FIXED] Removed collision from the ritual visual when someone dies.[/p][/*][*][p]\[FIXED] Can no longer tell if someone is dead from the Mute Players menu.[/p][/*][*][p]\[FIXED] Mic indicator not showing sometimes for your infected partner.[/p][/*][*][p]\[FIXED] Crouch triggering proximity chat.[/p][/*][*][p]\[FIXED] Shooting objective occasionally not registering Knuckle Duster hits.[/p][/*][*][p]\[FIXED] Being able to crouch when downed.[/p][/*][*][p]\[FIXED] Elevator is see-through from one side.[/p][/*][*][p]\[FIXED] Swimming pool bench collision being too high.[/p][/*][*][p]\[FIXED] Not being able to place traps in doorways.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2][b]Main[/b][/h2][h3][b]Improvements[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Players are now revealed to the Seer faster.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Fixes[/b][/h3][list][*][p]\[FIXED] Outlines not appearing on Teammates (Infected and Soulbound) during the Inbetween.[/p][/*][*][p]\[FIXED] Not being able to see your partner at night.[/p][/*][*][p]\[FIXED] Fixed various map exploits on Millhaven and Manor.[/p][/*][*][p]\[FIXED] Spectators not seeing camera pitch.[/p][/*][*][p]\[FIXED] Security Gates being closed at night.[/p][/*][*][p]\[FIXED] Finished ritual preventing interactions.[/p][/*][/list][p]
[/p][p]
[/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Deceit 2 - Hotfix: July 4, 2025
notes.content:
[p]Subjects,[/p][p]
[/p][p]Just a quick update  to address feedback from the community that came in following our Season launch. [/p][p][/p][p]As always, your feedback has been invaluable - please keep sharing your reports through Discord. [/p][p][/p][p]We’ll see you in The Ritual. [/p][p][/p][p]Improvements:[/p][list][*][p](Legacy) Reduced emissive light for Capture Point Objective and Lever Item detail UI.[/p][/*][*][p](Legacy) The player list now shows your Infected teammate’s selected Terror and Blood levels.[/p][/*][*][p](Legacy) Doors now open faster.[/p][/*][*][p](Legacy) You can now hear people when you are bleeding out.[/p][/*][*][p](Legacy) The shotgun reticle now gets smaller when aiming.[/p][/*][*][p](Legacy) Added two missing vents.[/p][/*][*][p](Legacy) Increased win XP amounts.[/p][/*][*][p](Legacy) Removed blur effect when oxygen is being drained.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved Glossary layout.[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced brightness on System Crash Monkey.[/p][/*][*][p]Optimised the Inbetween transition on Millhaven, Wurgen and Blackthorne Manor to reduce hitching and improve performance.[/p][/*][*][p]Added the Legacy pack to the in-game Store.[/p][/*][/list][p]
[/p][p]Fixes:[/p][list][*][p](FIXED) Glossary popup disappears as soon as it slides into view.[/p][/*][*][p](FIXED) Observer icon displays incorrectly on the Player Profile Wins screen.[/p][/*][*][p](FIXED) Pixel Pop Rachel skin top is misaligned with the arms.[/p][/*][*][p](FIXED) You cannot scroll through the legacy How To Play description text when using a gamepad.[/p][/*][*][p](FIXED) Players can’t move after the player they are executing disconnects in legacy mode.[/p][/*][*][p](FIXED) Grabbed players in legacy can be shot and damaged.[/p][/*][*][p](FIXED) Collision issues on the Centre Stairwell in the Asylum.[/p][/*][*][p](FIXED) XP is awarded when reviving a subject that has already been voted out.[/p][/*][*][p](FIXED) Play tab does not switch to Legacy mode when joining a Legacy party.[/p][/*][*][p](FIXED) Outlines on players with suspicion are coloured black.[/p][/*][*][p](FIXED) Crouching triggers proximity chat in Legacy Game Mode.[/p][/*][*][p](FIXED) Being able to remove armour from a Bleeding Out player.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Season 3: Neon Uprising & Legacy Mode
notes.content: [h1][b]Season 3: Neon Uprising & Legacy Mode[/b][/h1][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43698514/fe00f900542ed1f2cd500b18ff8b5f37c21942e2.png"][/img][/p][p]The shadows are glowing. The lies are louder. And the stakes are higher than ever. Whether you're a veteran player or stepping into Deceit for the first time, there's never been a better time to dive in.[/p][h2][b]LEGACY MODE RETURNS TO DECEIT 2[/b][/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43698514/0be025984321bb109b47076eb21b1fc0686528d4.png"][/img][/p][p]As we continue our development on Deceit 2, the original game’s infrastructure is getting older, and the game engine it uses has not been updated in 3 years. Rather than let it fade, we’re bringing its most iconic experience into the modern era - rebuilt, and now part of the future.[/p][p]Returning as a public beta, Legacy Mode resurrects the original 6-player, action-first format from Deceit 1.[/p][p]Each match runs across three floors, with day phases for item collection and blackout phases for carnage. Two players are [i]Infected[/i], hiding in plain sight. Four are [i]Innocent[/i], scrambling to escape. This is old-school Deceit - tense, fast, and punishing.[/p][p][b]Key Features:[/b][/p][list][*][p]6-player matches (4 Innocents vs 2 Infected)[/p][/*][*][p]Three-floor progression with fuse-based escape[/p][/*][*][p]No Innocent roles, no mutations[/p][/*][*][p]Terrors must earn blood and time their kills[/p][/*][*][p]Failing to place fuses triggers an [i]Enrage phase[/i] – Terrors execute without needing blood[/p][/*][*][p]Classic shoot-to-vote system with strict thresholds per floor[/p][/*][*][p]Survive and reach the Escape Door or prevent Innocents from escaping[/p][/*][*][p]A Deceit 2 take on the Terrors that adapts them to the Deceit 1 gameplay[/p][/*][/list][p]Legacy Mode rewards sharp instincts and fast thinking. Innocents must collaborate, gather light items, protect Antidote carriers, and track suspects. Infected players must stay coordinated, avoid getting caught drinking, and strike decisively.[/p][p]This is a public beta and will have some quirks. We will continue to iterate and develop Legacy with feedback from the community, and look forward to taking the original game mode further with you.[/p][h2][b]LEGACY DLC [/b][/h2][p]To celebrate Legacy Mode’s return, we’re unleashing a premium DLC pack loaded with returning fan favourites. You do not need the DLC in order to play the Legacy Mode game, however, this collection of classic cosmetic skins is available now for $19.99 and includes six fully themed characters:[/p][list][*][p][b]Holiday Enforcer Chang[/b] – suited up and locked in, festive justice style[/p][/*][*][p][b]Ace Queen Lisa[/b] – deadly elegance with a twisted royal flair[/p][/*][*][p][b]Mimette Nina[/b] – masked and mischievous, a harlequin of horror[/p][/*][*][p][b]Skeleton Hans[/b] – bones and bloodlust in perfect harmony[/p][/*][*][p][b]Boots & Blush Rachel[/b] – tactical and terrifying, with combat boots and style[/p][/*][*][p][b]Corpse Walker Alex[/b] – undead menace, shambling into the spotlight[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43698514/48524e448c5f1e24b9f01052b6a06869da8db1ce.gif"][/img][/p][p][b][i]All Legacy DLC cosmetics can be used in all Deceit 2 game modes. [/i][/b][/p][p]These cosmetics are available exclusively through the Legacy Mode DLC and won’t be added to any bundles or season tracks.[/p][h2][b]SEASON 3: NEON UPRISING – JULY 3 TO SEPTEMBER 3[/b][/h2][p]This Season’s track is charged with neon energy and synthetic chaos. Players who engage with the full Season will unlock a curated set of exclusive cosmetics, currency boosts, and more. The Season will run for a full two months and contains both free and premium reward paths. [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43698514/d6aac874655eaba0ed0766f4435c7351d26d580c.png"][/img][/p][p]The Season Pass is available now from the in-game store.[/p][p][b]LEGENDARY SKINS [/b][/p][list][*][p]Deadlink Chang[/p][/*][*][p]Nightbyte Lisa[/p][/*][*][p]Phase Tech Emblem[/p][/*][*][p]Phase Link Return Pad[/p][/*][*][p]Glitch Fang Werewolf[/p][/*][*][p]Revolution Loading Screen[/p][/*][*][p]Dark Frame Blindfold[/p][/*][*][p]Cyber Scanner Bag Scanner[/p][/*][*][p]Strike A Pose Emote[/p][/*][*][p]Prototype X Pistol[/p][/*][*][p]Pixelpop Rachel[/p][/*][*][p]Neon Nightmare Werewolf[/p][/*][*][p]Phase Void Return Pad[/p][/*][*][p]MossByte Lisa[/p][/*][*][p]Light Frame Blindfold[/p][/*][*][p]Prototype XI Pistol[/p][/*][*][p]Signal Burn Rachel[/p][/*][*][p]Redline Chang[/p][/*][/list][h2][b]ROCKSTAR BUNDLE – NOW IN THE GENERAL STORE[/b][/h2][p]Previously exclusive to PlayStation Plus, the Rockstar Bundle is now available to all players in the general store. This fan-favourite set blends chaos with attitude and includes:[/p][list][*][p][b]Rockstar Nina (Legendary)[/b] – leather, lights, and lethal charm[/p][/*][*][p][b]Microphone Flare (Legendary)[/b] – make your entrance loud and deadly[/p][/*][*][p][b]Jukebox Motion Sensor (Legendary)[/b] – movement detection with music on the side[/p][/*][*][p][b]Punk Handcuffs (Legendary)[/b] – stylish restraint for stylish takedowns[/p][/*][/list][p]No subscription required. No waiting. Just pure spectacle and sound.[/p][h2][b]PLAYSTATION PLUS: HERO BUNDLE - COMING SOON[/b][/h2][p]A brand-new PlayStation Plus bundle is coming out on July 10th, designed for players who want to bring righteous firepower into every match. Available exclusively to PS Plus subscribers, this bundle includes four Legendary-tier items:[/p][list][*][p][b]Alex Red Valour (Legendary)[/b] – a hero’s design with a blood-red finish[/p][/*][*][p][b]Immobiliser Pistol (Legendary)[/b] – freeze your foes mid-move[/p][/*][*][p][b]Plasma Pulse Light Trap (Legendary)[/b] – radiant, reactive, and lethal[/p][/*][*][p][b]Scarlet Cloak Smoke Grenade (Legendary)[/b] – vanish in style and emerge victorious[/p][/*][/list][p]This bundle will be free for eligible PS Plus players and can be claimed through the PlayStation Store.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43698514/ff10d66a9b403814f524c736fb3d6eeb4658de28.gif"][/img][/p][h2][b]ARCANE STORE ADDITIONS[/b][/h2][p]The Arcane Store expands once again with two disturbing new additions designed to unsettle and impress in equal measure:[/p][list][*][p][b]Blindfold[/b] – a cosmetic headpiece that limits vision but amplifies fear, draped in mythic design[/p][/*][*][p][b]Experiment[/b] – a skin born from failed trials and raw potential, pulsing with arcane corruption[/p][/*][/list][p]Both items are available now for Gems in the Arcane Store. Rotate your way to them before they vanish.[/p][h2][b]STARTER PACK – NEW PLAYER EXCLUSIVE[/b][/h2][p]For those stepping into the game for the first time, we’re introducing a brand-new Starter Pack tailored to jumpstart your Deceit journey. This bundle is available for just [b]1000 Shillings[/b] and can only be purchased within the first [b]seven days[/b] of account creation.[/p][p]Included in the Starter Pack:[/p][list][*][p]Access to [b]all core items[/b] (excluding DLC-exclusive content)[/p][/*][*][p]Full selection of [b]Mutations[/b] to customise your playstyle[/p][/*][*][p]1x [b]Common Key[/b] (100 Shillings value)[/p][/*][*][p]1x [b]Uncommon Key[/b] (200 Shillings value)[/p][/*][*][p]1x [b]Rare Key[/b] (400 Shillings value)[/p][/*][*][p]1x [b]Legendary Key[/b] (900 Shillings value)[/p][/*][*][p]5x [b]Blessings[/b] (225 Shillings total value)[/p][/*][/list][p]This is a time-limited opportunity for new players to unlock valuable tools from day one and compete on even footing from their first match.[/p][h2][b]WHAT’S NEXT FOR DECEIT 2[/b][/h2][p]Legacy Mode may be a return to our roots, but we’re not standing still. A brand-new map is already in development for Deceit 2, packed with fresh mechanics, eerie locations, and new layers of strategy.[/p][p]We’re not ready to lift the veil just yet… but here’s a glimpse at what’s stirring in the dark:[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43698514/830513752311c432bdfb583528af4bdca58cde06.gif"][/img][/p][p]The Ritual is evolving. And trust us — you won’t want to miss what comes next.[/p][p] [/p]

notes.title: Update 2.3 - The Observer
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43698514/8f5749ec1a1794079c2a92341e1bb621a4f0e2af.png"][/img][/p][p]Update 2.3 brings new chaos to the shadows of [i]Deceit 2[/i].[/p][p][/p][h2][b]New Innocent Role - Observer[/b][/h2][p][/p][p]Ever feel like you're being watched? You are now.[/p][p]The [i]Observer[/i] is a fresh addition to the innocent roster - a player equipped with surveillance-level insight. By activating their ability, the Observer can:[/p][list][*][p][b]Reveal all active and completed tasks[/b] on the map[/p][/*][*][p][b]Track who completed which task[/b] last[/p][/*][/list][p]Perfect for unmasking pretenders or verifying allies - assuming you can stay alive long enough to use it.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43698514/253f6d4b660285c3b19c8dc60ee8b8f016be7eb6.png"][/img][/p][h2][b]New Mutation - Paranormal[/b][/h2][p][/p][p][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXf1j8cfOH66fyoKn5hilvmvUKaNkbBOXkx5pvbbFLiWt9XRDQEF2XnylNT8ZwU7Oh3sqn4UXEcxYuRqM2tQGXWeM7HgPC4EGipBeTfNE8jftWwN34sTKoWfmDAA_YfvkuJRLaQcsg?key=WRQRIzdBl_eKT__nVq0HxQ"][/img][/p][p][b]Back from the beyond.
[/b][i]Paranormal[/i] returns to the rotation after earlier testing, bringing its signature brand of midday madness.[/p][list][*][p]During the [b]Day Phase[/b], all players enter [b]ghost form[/b] for 20 seconds. [/p][/*][/list][p]With everyone in Ghost form, it’s the perfect moment for the Infected to make their move.[/p][p][/p][h2][b]New Mutation - Nonsense[/b][/h2][p][/p][p][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXddHySBlW3sxzhLj-w1xeNYjJ2cYNP6hwVdm-yQ6665dmntF5LuUzxvyrKptOqZE7-Lmu-jNFitNQl1LttBksBa9kijRa0s42e0f8N_Ab0uzvj4jXk01XhnLctbXeQTwZRb6_3hBQ?key=WRQRIzdBl_eKT__nVq0HxQ"][/img][/p][p]You asked for chaos - you got it.[/p][p]The [i]Nonsense[/i] mutation floods matches with unpredictable, player-specific audio cues designed to confuse, mislead, and dismantle trust. These sounds will continue randomly until the current phase ends.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Reality Phase[/b][/h3][p]Random fake alerts may include:[/p][list][*][p]Weak point activation[/p][/*][*][p]Motion Sensor trigger[/p][/*][*][p]Invisibility Medallion use[/p][/*][*][p]Gunfire[/p][/*][*][p]Smoke or Gas Grenade detonation[/p][/*][*][p]Menace activation[/p][/*][*][p]“Chemist poisoned all” alert[/p][/*][*][p]“Warden is banishing” alert[/p][/*][*][p]Mimic Copy use[/p][/*][*][p]Soulbound partner chosen [/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]Inbetween Phase[/b][/h3][p]Prepare for chaos with fake:[/p][list][*][p]Experiment dash screams[/p][/*][*][p]Werewolf howls[/p][/*][*][p]Vampire teleports[/p][/*][*][p]Monkey “Go Banana” screams[/p][/*][*][p]Terror transformations [/p][/*][/list][p][i]Each player hears different sounds.[/i] Paranoia has been weaponised. [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43698514/253f6d4b660285c3b19c8dc60ee8b8f016be7eb6.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2][b]VFX Changes[/b] [/h2][p][/p][p][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXfaF0IYIsVoRe-NHPi65tuxvTuDYRKgh7Kqv9NcYYNQrE2tdx2BVVK3dsofrcKtG8GzxvVykeLHU-RmLH1axG1ZAF5vtcWybMNQvRY7miJWb1QSvSJ56C0iOpEYESlRRYQn6xsBxA?key=WRQRIzdBl_eKT__nVq0HxQ"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]We've added a gradual dissolve effect to the characters as they get transported to the Inbetween, turn invisible, or transform into a terror. This should help improve the game's theming and immersion, making the transition between phases more seamless. [/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXdt_XIFiglLsAFWZnl-9-B0ep9gm9go6FDQaYHAeGz6kTh0vVgP1Y938SfyGTz-DDDj1KlTHJr3IUfXVlFq4dPPBYdUeowwyK7i-DoHHh3ZSAMG29mMIuZPBnSPQLjxONLO8Sf5?key=WRQRIzdBl_eKT__nVq0HxQ"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Update 2.3 gives Innocents new tools and Infected new tricks.[/p][p]Every move matters now - especially when it comes to tasks.[/p][p]Pay attention to who’s completing them... and who’s just pretending.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]See you in the ritual! [/b][/h3][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43698514/253f6d4b660285c3b19c8dc60ee8b8f016be7eb6.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]Patch Notes[/h2][p][/p][h3][b]Balance Changes:[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Decreased handcuff duration from 30s -> 20s[/p][/*][*][p]Increased the Rift Eye inactivity after being stunned.[/p][/*][*][p]Phantom now is cleansed from Ball & Chain, Handcuffs, and Player trackers when transforming into the Menace.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Fixes:[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed issue with Hans’ face where a higher LOD was showing at the incorrect screen size.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Update 2.2 - Blessings Update
notes.content:
The Ritual demands more. With Update 2.2, we’re revisiting how you earn your place in the game and how you dress for the part. Blessings have been reforged, Arcane Skins are back with a vengeance, and Legacy Mode prepares to make its full return.

[h2]Blessings Crushing System[/h2]
You've asked for better ways to complete the Season Pass - and we're answering.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43698514/56de8a41bb150502b4a9ba40d106d9e532f10202.jpg[/img]
We’ve split Blessings into two distinct types, each with their own role in the Ritual:

[h3]Drink Blessings[/h3]
Before the Ritual begins, Subjects have the option to drink a Blessing, which grants all Subjects of the Ritual temporary access to every Terror and Curse without any cost. This provides a chance to explore all available options in the Store.

In addition to this, you will earn Double XP as a reward.

[h3]Smashing Blessings[/h3]
Subjects can choose to smash Blessings in batches of 1x, 5x, or 10x.Each smashed Blessing grants +1000 Season XP.

Unlike drinking, smashed Blessings affect only you – no shared bonuses, no Terror access, no double XP.

Smashing is instant. It happens outside the Ritual. No ceremony. No waiting.

Use it to catch up. Use it to push ahead.

[h2]New Arcane Skins – Chang & Decoy[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43698514/e5a4dfcfdaa8dfb3371a26ca011b06a2a9cbeb06.png[/img]
Two new Arcane items have surfaced - and they’re anything but subtle.
[list]
[*] Arcane Chang
[*] Arcane Decoy
[/list]
Both are available now in the store, exclusively with Gems.

[h2]Legacy Mode – Final Testing Phase[/h2]
Legacy Mode development is entering the final stretch. After 8 focused playtests - and with 2 more scheduled this week - we’re closing in on the return of classic Deceit gameplay. Over 300 community testers have helped us pressure-test this mode, uncovering bugs, refining balance, and ensuring it channels the original tension and paranoia players remember.

To mark the occasion, we’re releasing the Legacy Bundle DLC alongside launch. This pack revives six iconic outfits from Deceit 1 -
[list]
[*] Zombie Alex
[*] Nutcracker Chang
[*] Boots & Blush Rachel
[*] Ace Queen Lisa
[*] Skeleton Crew Hans
[*] Mimette Nina
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43698514/f6c90357fa906867f54d6f97e110318a472e12c9.png[/img]

Each skin has been reimagined for Deceit 2, honouring the past while embracing the present. More details coming soon.

Legacy is nearly here, and it’s going to change the game. 

[b]See you in the Ritual! [/b]

[h2]Patch Notes[/h2]

Balance Changes:

[list]
[*] Flare duration has been nerfed from 10s -> 5s
[*] Weakpoint breaking sound attenuation has been reduced by ~25%
[*] Tannoy is no longer usable at night
[/list]

notes.title: Update 2.1 - Circus Changes
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43698514/f9d3f1c752307e6085084a14b6ea74ddf4a46347.png[/img]

Update 2.1 is here, bringing a wave of bug fixes, quality of life improvements, and a focused rework of one of Deceit 2’s latest maps: The Circus.

[h2]Circus Layout Rework — Shaped by Your Feedback[/h2]
We’ve been listening closely to community feedback and made key changes to the Circus map to improve gameplay flow and pacing:
[list]
[*] Open spaces have been broken up into more distinct “rooms,” creating clearer engagement areas and better navigation.
[*] Additional pathways into the central area have been added, giving you more options for movement, flanking, and outplaying your opponents.
[/list]
[b]Regarding Eye Placement:[/b]
We know some players have concerns about Eye positions. For now, we’re holding off on changes until we see how these new layout tweaks affect gameplay.

Jump into a few matches and let us know how it feels.

[h2]Bug Fixes & Quality of Life Improvements[/h2]
Alongside the Circus update, we’ve addressed a number of community-reported bugs and polished various aspects of the game to improve overall stability and playability.

For the full list of fixes, check out the patch notes below.

[h2]Legacy Mode — Built With the Community[/h2]
Our work on Legacy Mode continues to be a major focus. We’re refining the experience with direct input from community playtests, ensuring it feels both faithful to Deceit 1 and exciting for Deceit 2 players.

Here’s what some of our playtesters are saying:
[list]
[*] [b]Doritos Yarok: [/b]"Like Deceit 1 on steroids"
[*] [b]KimchiDelRey:[/b] "A lively mode that offers a lot of fun and puts a new, but familiar spin to the game."
[*] [b]Estel:[/b] "Weird in the sense of fun."
[*] [b]City:[/b] "Really captures legacy Deceit 1's vibe of fast-paced chaotic fun."
[*] [b]quesnay:[/b] "Feels old but new at the same time — a great and refreshing experience."
[*] [b]Böttcher:[/b] "Sehr gut."
[*] [b]kikiex_:[/b] "Astonishing work — represents legacy Deceit very well."
[*] [b]Classer Gamer:[/b] "A treat for both new and returning players."
[*] [b]The Communist:[/b] "Fresh, nostalgic, and fun for all skill levels."
[*] [b]Biliousdrake:[/b] "3 Floors of Fun. D1 but highly improved. Couldn't stop playing."
[*] [b]SewFiii:[/b] “Deceit 2 Legacy Mode proves that social deduction can provide a cut throat competitive experience. The straightforward, yet tense, combat is dangerously paired with sharp questioning exchanges working towards convincing your peers to trust you in the hopes you all might escape The Game Master.”
[/list]
With more playtests planned, your feedback will continue to shape Legacy Mode into a standout experience for both veterans and newcomers.

[h2]What’s Next — The Future of Deceit 2[/h2]
While Update 2.1 focuses on fixes and refinement, we’re also looking ahead to the future:

A brand new map is in development, more to come on this soon.

A new Cursed role is on the horizon, designed to twist the dynamics of deception in unexpected ways. 

Legacy Mode remains a primary focus, with ongoing community playtests and iterations leading up to its full release.

Every piece of feedback — whether it’s about maps, modes, or roles — helps shape Deceit 2 into the game it deserves to be. Keep sharing your thoughts. Keep playing. And keep an eye on what’s coming next.

New maps. New roles. New ways to deceive.

See you in the Ritual!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43698514/253f6d4b660285c3b19c8dc60ee8b8f016be7eb6.png[/img]

[h2]Patch Notes[/h2]
[h3]Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] [Fixed] Being able to open shop after teleporting with return pad.
[*] [Fixed] Not being able to set suspicion for the players that left the game.
[*] [Fixed] Millhaven scanner giving wrong results if the player got up as they were getting scanned.
[*] [Fixed] Soulbound not dying when their partner dies.
[*] [Fixed] Warden being able to use their ability at the start of the game.
[*] [Fixed] Occasionally it is possible to get into a state of not being able to open a Peddler Shop.
[*] [Fixed] Werewolf leap being able to go through a crack.
[*] [Fixed] End of Game Screen not positioning infected correctly if there were more than two (Incl. Mimic).
[*] [Fixed] Sanity regeneration setting not working.
[*] [Fixed] Various map exploits
[*] [Fixed] Custom setting for sanity regen
[/list]

[h3]Improvements[/h3]
[list]
[*] You are now able to see the title and the emblem of your friends and friend requests.
[*] Friend list is now sorted by Online->InGame->Offline. In-game was assigned its own colour.
[*] Improved visuals of daily login screen
[*] It is no longer possible to grab a player through the crack in the second half of the animation.
[*] Added emblems to the Q menu; spectator and friend list.
[/list]

notes.title: Season 2: Ritual Of The Blade
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43698514/532272d8193d9dba936bc8cc4406ff071980eed7.png[/img]
Season 2 unveils a world shaped by silent strikes, ancient traditions, and ruthless precision. Master every challenge with the discipline of a true warrior.

[h2]Season Pass Rewards[/h2]
Will you walk the path of the hidden blade?
Unlock a collection crafted for warriors who thrive in shadow and triumph with honour.

[h3]Upgrade with the Premium Bundle[/h3]
Prepare yourself for battle:

[list]
[*] Premium Pass — Unlock every reward this season.
[*] 30,000 Season XP — Accelerate your rise through the ranks.
[*] 4 Crypt Keys — Unearth cosmetics hidden deep within the Crypt.
[/list]
[h3]Legendary Rewards: Wield Power, Wear Honour[/h3]

Ascend through the mists and claim legendary treasures forged by skill, tradition, and fate:
[list]
[*] Crimson Warrior – Nina (Cosmetic)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43698514/f6745f4825559c64898ea1ed682bf62089be3277.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43698514/470d7dbbad28ca73196097c12e4fb6b0aebc1698.gif[/img]
[*] Dark King – Vampire (Terror Skin)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43698514/8676633831fec337a067b1e8bc9286094e300b47.gif[/img]

[h2]New Arcane Items[/h2]

Three new Arcane items have arrived in the store: the Clown, the Torch, and the Emblem. Each one brings its own twisted flair—and they’re available now, exclusively with Gems.

[h2]Emblems[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43698514/de4a28330028421aa0121a6f7db897e7a2f061a6.png[/img]
The Emblem System is now live! Emblems let you show off your in-game achievements—and this is just the beginning. In the coming weeks, we’ll be enhancing visibility and impact across the board.

We’re keen to hear what you think. Got feedback or ideas? Jump into our [Discord] and share your thoughts. Emblems can be set in the Profile Tab and is currently displayed when looking at a party member’s profile.

[h2]Easter Event Concludes — What’s Next?[/h2]

Looking ahead, we’re already planning our next in-game event for later this summer — stay tuned for more details!

In the meantime, we’d love to hear your thoughts on how we can make future events even better. Keep an eye on the [ Discord] where we’ll be gathering your feedback soon.

notes.title: Update 1.3 - The Easter Event
notes.content:
[b]Update 1.3[/b] has arrived—bringing fresh cosmetics, brand-new Profile Rewards, and a festive Easter Event. This seasonal update kicks off a wave of changes leading into Season 2. Let’s dive in.

[h2]Spring Has Sprung in Millhaven – Easter Event Now Live[/h2]
The chaos gets a cheerful twist—our limited-time Easter Event is here, running from April 17th to May 1st.

Expect egg-fuelled gadgets, bunny-themed cosmetics, and plenty of reasons to dive back in. It’s deception, dressed for spring.

[h3]Here’s how it works:[/h3]
Scavenge during the event to earn Event Points and unlock festive rewards. Each item you find adds to your tally:

[list]
[*] Item 1: +10 Event Points
[*] Item 2: +20 Event Points
[*] Item 3: +30 Event Points
[*] Item 4: +40 Event Points
[*] Item 5: +50 Event Points
[/list]
The more you collect, the better the haul. Hop to it.

[h2]Easter Event Items[/h2]

Gather the following items with event points or you can purchase them with Shillings, here’s the full breakdown: 

[b]Bunny Bliss Priya – A seasonal cosmetic for Priya[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43698514/0fbad131ce07f30afa092cc462ae69b5510001f5.png[/img]

[b]Bunny Motion Sensor[/b] – A fluffy twist on your tactical tools
[b]Egg Grenade – A themed[/b] – Gas Grenade reskin for seasonal chaos[/b]
[b]Hoplink Walkie Talkie[/b] – Even your comms are getting festive[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43698514/03a05a3efaae02e26484a184310c6cd0336dcc4e.png[/img]

[b]Hidden Easter Eggs – Scattered throughout the maps— how many can you find?[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43698514/253f6d4b660285c3b19c8dc60ee8b8f016be7eb6.png[/img]

[h2]New Store Items – Chocolate Bunnies[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43698514/3aa59b556772ceae93fbb73d64bf34bc09e8433f.png[/img]
Looking to add something sweet to your collection? Two Chocolate Bunny Experiment cosmetics have hopped into the store:

[list]
[*] Ruby Chocolate Bunny – 600 Shillings
[*] White Chocolate Bunny – 600 Shillings
[/list]
Both are exclusive cosmetics, so grab them while they’re still on the shelves!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43698514/253f6d4b660285c3b19c8dc60ee8b8f016be7eb6.png[/img]

[h2]Daily Login Update – Coming May 1st[/h2]
We’re updating how daily login rewards work, starting May 1st. Currently, players receive one of each key rarity, but we’re shifting to Master Keys only. 

[h3]Why the change?[/h3]
[list]
[*] Master Keys can offer any reward rarity, giving you more chances at what you actually want
[*] This adds more variety and value to your daily login streaks
[*] The change starts May 1st, just in time for Season 2
[/list]
We’ve heard your feedback and believe this tweak adds more flexibility and potential rewards each day you log in.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43698514/253f6d4b660285c3b19c8dc60ee8b8f016be7eb6.png[/img]

[h2]Profile Tab Rewards Now Live[/h2]
You can now earn Master Crypt Keys, Emotes, Emblems, and Victory Poses just by levelling up each character. It's a big boost to progression—and it’s all tracked through the Profile tab.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43698514/4840db7ab7a78711aac064dcfe21248d83c06be2.png[/img]

[h3]Here’s what’s changed:[/h3]
[list]
[*] All progression rewards are now automatically granted
[*] If you’ve levelled up recently, check your Profile tab to claim any backlog
[*] Rewards are character-specific, so there’s more reason than ever to try new playstyles
[/list]
This update makes progression in Deceit 2 more rewarding, more visible, and a lot more satisfying.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43698514/253f6d4b660285c3b19c8dc60ee8b8f016be7eb6.png[/img]

[h2]Emblem System Support (Coming Soon)[/h2]
Emblem system support is now included in-game, laying the groundwork for player profile customisation. While the feature is currently disabled, you may notice traces of it as we finalise the launch experience.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43698514/35dc49021abc044f5f56113d20ab3b579431bb30.png[/img]

We're holding back the release briefly to ensure everything functions as intended. Once live, players will be able to personalise their profiles and display earned emblems—starting with the Deceit 1 legacy emblems we committed to before launch.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43698514/253f6d4b660285c3b19c8dc60ee8b8f016be7eb6.png[/img]

[h2]Legacy Update – Progressing Well[/h2]
Many of you have been asking about the Legacy Update. We’re happy to report that internal testing and limited community tests have been going very well. We’re seeing a lot of positive feedback, and we’re continuing to polish and improve the experience based on what we’re seeing.

Thanks to everyone who's taken the time to help test it—your feedback has been invaluable. We look forward to the next round of testing on Thursday 24th April. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43698514/253f6d4b660285c3b19c8dc60ee8b8f016be7eb6.png[/img]

That’s everything for Update 1.3! We hope you enjoy the Easter Event and all the quality-of-life changes we’ve made. Season 2 is just around the corner, and we can’t wait to show you what’s next.

[b]See you in The Ritual! [/b]

[h2]Improvements:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Some collection tabs have been turned from 3x3 grids to a list of all the items. This allows us to delete single-use assets and decrease the game size.
[*] Skins are now listed in order of rarity.
[*] Added VFX to implant when voting
[*] Mic HUD icon colour now matches the team that is talking (e.g. Infected voice chat will have the mic icon turn red, Soulbound is purple)
[/list]
Increase speed on various tasks:
[list]

[*] [Blackthorne Manor] Graveyard Zombies
[*] [Blackthorne Manor] Seagulls
[/list]
[h2]Fixes:[/h2]

[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.1 - The Hellbreakers
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43698514/f5e918c1547c3a9c7a46d8a3a4aad89cbbc8f42c.png[/img]

The flames of deception burn hotter than ever—The Hellbreakers have risen.

This update unleashes four hellish new skins, transforming each Terror into a molten nightmare. 

Born from betrayal and consumed by torment, these Terrors were once souls that strayed too close to forbidden power. Now, twisted by The Inbetween, they exist only to spread chaos and destruction.

[h2]THE HELLBREAKERS ARE HERE[/h2]

Each Terror has been reforged in fire and brimstone, emerging as a nightmare from the depths of hell:

[b][h3]The Hellfury (Clown) - The Infernal Jester.[/h3][/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43698514/1ff94780f2aedbdb0b14f49da5f59557c5558104.gif[/img]
A trickster consumed by rage, The Hellfury was cast into the abyss for his insatiable thirst for chaos. Reborn in molten fury, he revels in destruction, and his infernal presence scorches the ground beneath him.

[b][h3]The Hellhound (Werewolf) - The Ashen Beast[/h3][/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43698514/2c756351d8566c3c300976a47a4d1b5733cee315.gif[/img]
The Hellhound was bound in chains that now burn with eternal fire. Darting between realms with a mocking grin, he turns fear into a game, ensnaring victims before they even realise they’re trapped.

[b][h3]The Hellborne (Vampire) - The Winged Firefury[/h3][/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43698514/e3d121f6f6f5123f87fea5a5a50750010bd22341.gif[/img]
The Hellborne sought to escape death—only to be consumed by something far worse. His wings, charred by flame, cast an ominous shadow, and his thirst for life is now an endless void.

[b][h3]The Hellmare (Experiment) - The Unchained Horror[/h3][/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43698514/bca4b10b79d84b7f518af88f17516939c933c740.gif[/img]
A failed experiment, The Hellmare was abandoned, left to rot in agony—until The Inbetween claimed him. Now an unstoppable force of destruction, his body is a furnace of raw energy, and his wrath is as limitless as the flames that engulf him.

Grab each of these hellish demons in store now for 600 shillings each!

Will you survive, or will you burn?

[h2]Balance Changes & Community-Driven Adjustments[/h2]
Alongside these terrifying new skins, Update 1.1 introduces a series of balancing changes shaped by your feedback. We’ve been listening closely to the community, analysing gameplay data, and fine-tuning key mechanics to ensure a more balanced and engaging experience.

[b][h3]TERROR CHANGES[/h3][/b]
With the introduction of two new Innocent roles, the Infected have been left slightly behind in terms of power.

These changes are intended to be the start of a shift towards buffing this team. We want to be careful with the changes and tweaks, so please don’t expect them to be the complete solution, but instead as a step in the right direction.

[b][h3]INBETWEEN[/h3][/b]
These changes should make the Inbetween arrive faster and last longer.
Passive Inbetween Gain increased by 5%
Passive Inbetween Drain decreased by 5%

[b][h3]VAMPIRE[/h3][/b]
We wanted to address some points with the Vampire - that being the same players getting repeatedly targeted by the Bat. The Vampire was in a very strong state beforehand, but we will be keeping a close eye on it in the future to see if it needs some commensurate buffs.

[list]
[*] Increased Bat cooldown from 10s → 15s
[*] Decreased sanity drain from Bat from 15 → 10
[/list]

[b][h3]CLOWN[/h3][/b]
We have buffed speed for the Morgus, allowing him to keep pace with other players and roles more easily.  (For reference, a sprinting Human has a speed of 650) - 
Increased all movement speeds (including Go Bananas) by 25:

[list]
[*] Sad: 600 → 625
[*] Neutral: 625 → 650
[*] Happy: 650 → 675
[*] Go Bananas: 675 → 700
[/list]

[b][h3]ITEM CHANGES[/h3][/b]
One concern raised by the community is that the Pistol, Camera, and Sanity Serum can feel like essential purchases, which can make matches feel repetitive by limiting player choice. While the Pistol is a core part of Deceit and will remain a common item, we want to minimise the number of items that feel mandatory.

[b][h3]SANITY SERUM[/h3][/b]
The Sanity Serum remains a strong item, but this change will give the Terrors a little more counter play as they can grab you before you’ve gained back most of your sanity.
Now restores 75 sanity over 3 seconds

[b][h3]TORCH[/h3][/b]
Like the Sanity Serum, the Camera has been the premier light item players use. For this we made a slight tweak to the Torch, making it much easier to aim but reducing the charge. This should much improve the Quality of Life of the torch making it much more appealing to use without making it overpowered.

[list]
[*] Decreased Torch charge from 20s → 16s
[*] Increased Torch angle from 5 → 7 (making it easier to hit)
[/list]

These changes wouldn’t be possible without the community’s passion and insights. Your feedback is crucial in shaping Deceit, and we’ll continue monitoring, adjusting, and improving the game based on how you play. Keep sharing your thoughts—every update brings us closer to the best Deceit experience possible.

[h2]COMING SOON:[/h2]
But The Hellbreakers are just the beginning—this season is packed with more changes, new content, and surprises yet to be revealed.

[list]
[*] Legacy Playtesting – Launching very soon, giving you an early look at what’s ahead - sign up on the [url=https://discord.com/invite/deceit]Discord[/url].
[*] Profile Rewards – A new way to claim hard-earned rewards is on the way.
[*] Easter Event – A special limited-time event is coming.
[/list]

Check out the [url=https://trello.com/b/IokOn6IO]Roadmap[/url] for our full development timeline

Are you ready to unleash Hell in The Inbetween? 

See you in The Ritual.

[h2]Patch Notes[/h2]

[h3]Improvements[/h3]
[list]
[*] Improved Pick up and Place task item holding positions - this was most notable on the hippopotamus’s watermelon.
[*] Players are now more visible to the Seer in the Inbetween.
[*] Added sound to speakers when destroyed
[*] When adding friends, they no longer go automatically to the bottom of the friend list.
[*] Players can now set their title if they no longer have one.
[*] Reduced brightness on Return Pad lights.
[*] Reduced brightness on yellow Wurgen security key screen.
[*] Updated character portraits for major popups.
[*] Waypoints are removed from your screen while downed or grabbed by a terror.
[*] Added a light when voting on players.
[*] Updated icons on the winning screen.
[/list]

[h3]Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed issue where rarity percentage of title didn’t appear on the Title Selection screen.
[*] Fixed issue where Circus Turret Tasks would appear completed incorrectly.
[*] Fixed issue where emote face animations wouldn’t play.
[*] Fixed key equip animation
[*] Fixed issue where Invisibility Medallion would end preemptively.
[*] Fixed rift eye visible during the day time on circus
[*] Fixed multiple map exploits
[*] Fixed issue where silencer on “Quiet Strike” would block your view while in ADS.
[*] Fixed issue where werewolf would have permanent outlines on players.
[*] Fixed issue where light traps wouldn’t activate if you place multiple on top of each other.
[*] Fixed issue where you could only shoot through Millhaven windows one way.
[/list]

notes.title: Year 8 Season 1 - Shadows & Secrets
notes.content:
Deceit turns eight, and with it, a new era begins. Year 8, Season 1 marks a rebirth and an homage to our roots, wrapped in the intrigue of refined British espionage. Only those willing to embrace the shadows will uncover the truth. We have kept our greatest surprise towards the end of this update - go on, skip ahead.  We’ll wait.

You’re back?  Excellent.  Let’s begin…

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43698514/253f6d4b660285c3b19c8dc60ee8b8f016be7eb6.png[/img]

[h2]Season Pass Improvements[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43698514/9a942589cb0524c3d0d646d3bcc845c221ef1200.png[/img]
Season 1 delivers a world of calculated chaos and covert operations. Every element is designed with precision:

[list]
[*] (Double-oh) Seven Rewards per Page: Each dossier unfolds like a classified file, culminating in a final Legendary reward worth the pursuit.
[*] Quality Over Quantity: Rewards are streamlined from 90 to 70. Every unlock is essential—no wasted space, no dead weight, fewer T-shirts. 
[/list]

The mission remains balanced—the core season takes the same time to complete, but the Bonus Page now demands true dedication to unlock. Only the most committed agents will claim it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43698514/253f6d4b660285c3b19c8dc60ee8b8f016be7eb6.png[/img]

[h2]Season Pass Rewards[/h2]

Dive into Shadows and Secrets with a Season Pass designed for the most cunning operatives. Will you uncover every reward hidden in the darkness?

[h3]Upgrade with the Premium Bundle [/h3]

Stay ahead of the game with the Premium Bundle:

[list]
[*] Premium Pass – Unlock every classified reward this season.
[*] 30,000 Season XP – Accelerate your rise through the ranks.
[*] 4 Crypt Keys – Secure high-value assets from the Crypt.
[/list]

The mission starts now.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43698514/253f6d4b660285c3b19c8dc60ee8b8f016be7eb6.png[/img]

[h2]Brand New Cosmetics[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43698514/ddc2145b8845107bc3d5b4802d7ee934b662fe24.png[/img]

Equip yourself with a curated arsenal, designed for the discerning operative:

[b]Precision Ink – Sanity Serum[/b]
For when the line between clarity and madness blurs.

[b]Quick ‘n’ Clean – Pistol[/b]
A sleek, reliable weapon designed for swift, precise action.

[b]Quartermaster – Beck[/b]
A trusted ally, fully equipped to support any mission with unmatched expertise.

[b]Classic Covert – Hans[/b]
Understated elegance endures, even in the dark.

[b]Shaken or Stirred? – Emote[/b]
A measured nod to the classics—a gesture of cool detachment.

[b]Going Dark – Heat Goggles[/b]
When vanishing is the only strategy.

[b]Shadow Operative – Rachel[/b]
A whisper in the gloom.

[b]Fist of Deception – Knuckle Duster[/b]
When subtlety meets necessity.

[b]Brains and Brawn – Experiment[/b]
Where intellect meets unrelenting power.

[h3]SEASON PASS EXCLUSIVES:[/h3]

[b]Quiet Strike – Pistol[/b]
For those who know discretion is key.

[b]Agent Noir – Hans[/b]
A familiar face, touched with mystery.

[b]Operation Whiteout – Rachel[/b]
Composure under pressure.

[b]Mission Failed – Experiment[/b]
Proof that even the best-laid plans can fail.

[h2]Arcane[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43698514/ff0cfea985fae1acad3e93bb20c830bf120cf75b.gif[/img]

Visit the Arcane Store and uncover two new relics of the unseen:

[b]The Werewolf[/b]

[b]The Camera[/b]

Cloaked in deep purples and eerie energy, these items exude a presence beyond the ordinary. 

[i]Claimable only with Gems.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43698514/253f6d4b660285c3b19c8dc60ee8b8f016be7eb6.png[/img]

[h2]A Birthday Tribute[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43698514/9b3409ca9bca6ab7d0c94cdec6032ad6bbf7351a.gif[/img]

Step into the darkness and emerge transformed. The Blood Bath Skin, a deadly evolution of the original Deceit 2 Awaken skin for the Experiment, is here to make its mark.

This skin vanishes from the store on [b]April 3rd[/b]. Secure it before it’s lost to the Ritual.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43698514/253f6d4b660285c3b19c8dc60ee8b8f016be7eb6.png[/img]

[h2]A New Chapter in Your Training: Profile & Levels Overhaul[/h2]
Subjects,

Your dossiers have been updated. The Game Master has been watching, and now it’s time to prove your worth. Your profile now reflects your skill, cunning, and victories.

[h3]Your Profile: A Record of Deception[/h3]

Team victories take centre stage—no more redundant team levels. You don’t choose your allies, but you do decide how well you outplay them.

[h1]COMING SOON [/h1]
[h2]Character Progression: A Reward for Mastery[/h2]

Unlock exclusive rewards at key levels, including Emblems and Victory Poses, to showcase your progression and dedication. 

Here's a preview of what you can expect to unlock as you level up:

[list]
[*] Level 5 – Common Crypt Key
[*] Level 10 – Agent Face Sticker
[*] Level 15 – Uncommon Crypt Key
[*] Level 25 – NEW Emblem
[*] Level 35 – Rare Crypt Key
[*] Level 50 – Character Specific Emote
[*] Level 75 – Legendary Crypt Key
[*] Level 100 – NEW Upgraded Victory Pose
[/list]

[h2]LEGACY MODE: THE ORIGINAL GAME REBORN[/h2]

Our final announcement this week… The past awakens.

Legacy Mode revives the heart-pounding action of Deceit 1 within Deceit 2’s chilling world of deduction. The best of both—terror, tension, and deception—coming soon to PC and console.

Fast action. Sharp deduction. One ultimate Deceit experience.

Sign up on Discord to be among the first to play in our upcoming pre-release test—coming very soon.


The past whispers. Will you answer?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43698514/253f6d4b660285c3b19c8dc60ee8b8f016be7eb6.png[/img]

Year 8 Season 1: Shadows and Secrets merges elegance with subterfuge—a tribute to our British heritage and the cold, calculated artistry of the Game Master. Every decision is deliberate, every action judged.

And as for the past? Well, some secrets refuse to stay buried.

[b]Good luck, Double-oh—uh, Agent… Stand by for further intel.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43698514/8365c070361a595b0eac165a829c4a51045f83d5.png[/img]

[h2]Improvements[/h2]

notes.title: Update 6.3 - Bug Fixes

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43698514/24b3b9c62bc011da123f6fbf59a9ca13aaacec66.png[/img]

[b]To our Community,[/b]

We hear you. Update 6.2 came with its share of issues—FPS drops, input delay, UI glitches, and some inconsistencies. We know this has been frustrating, and we sincerely apologise for the disruption.

As part of our commitment to keeping Deceit 2 at the forefront of technical improvements, we upgraded to Unreal Engine 5.5 early to ensure long-term benefits for performance, visuals, and stability. That said, with any major update comes the risk of unforeseen issues, and we appreciate your patience while we work through them. We are an ambitious studio and we like to move fast, this time, we moved a little too far, and a little too quickly.

Today, we’re releasing Update 6.3 to address the most pressing bugs and performance concerns reported by the community. This patch focuses on fixing critical issues, improving stability, and ensuring a smoother gameplay experience.

Your feedback has been invaluable in helping us respond quickly—please keep sharing your reports through [official channels]. With this patch focused on fixes, our next update will bring exciting new content, so stay tuned.

notes.title: Update 6.2 - New Innocent Roles
notes.content:
[b]Subjects,[/b]

The tide shifts. The cycle turns. The game deepens. Change is here—whether you welcome it or not.

[h1]Two More to the Slaughter – New Innocent Roles[/h1]

This update brings not one, but two fresh Innocents into the Ritual.  Each brings a unique way to shift the balance.

One seeks to weaken the darkness, tearing away its grip before it tightens. The other lingers at the edge of the veil, glimpsing truths only the dead can share.

[h2]The Purifier[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43698514/e9541fe9b2b2521b6b4c997ed7ab874d32b0c102.gif[/img]
[list]
[*] You can deactivate active Blood Altars, disrupting the Infected’s progress.
[*] You will lose 15 sanity upon deactivating a blood altar.
[*] You see in-between progress as you work to disable an Altar.
[*] The Chemist can block you from deactivating Blood Altars.
[*] Infected can now deactivate Blood Altars - this is to ensure that it is not 100% clear that the Purifier is innocent. 
[/list]
We recommend communicating with the Inquisitor for an effective strategy.

[h2]The Medium[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43698514/f859fd32350c7ce299308e08170c4e0bea4b8382.gif[/img]
[list]
[*] The success banish circle will now spawn from every death.
[*] If a player gets banished, a spirit of them appears above their banishment circle—visible only to you.
[*] Three times a game you can interact with the Banished to witness this apparition.
[*] The spirit reveals their team affiliation, displaying their colour and team symbol, Innocent, Infected or Cursed.
[*] Spirits do not have collision—they are ethereal, after all!
[*] The Chemist can block you from spawning the spirits
[/list]
[h2]Updated Role Distribution[/h2]
With the introduction of two new roles, we have increased the number of innocent roles per game. We all know the feeling of drawing the standard ‘human’ role. This change should make things a little more interesting.

For games with 7–9 players, the number of Innocent roles increases to four. Games with fewer than 7 players remain unchanged

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43698514/253f6d4b660285c3b19c8dc60ee8b8f016be7eb6.png[/img]

[h1]The Hunt Refined – Chase System Updates[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43698514/a738705b6221c84d09cb27daf8145a199c42995b.png[/img]

A new year brings sharper edges to the hunt. We’re continuing to refine Deceit 2’s gameplay to heighten tension, reduce frustration, and deepen the mind games. This update fine-tunes the chase loop, enhances movement, and reworks some of the maps.

[h2]Chasing the Core of Deceit 2[/h2]
Deceit 2 hinges on two core gameplay loops. The first is the social deduction loop: unravelling identities, planting seeds of doubt, and executing deception. It’s the heart of Deceit 2 and the foundation of every encounter.

The second core loop is the chase. This loop dominates the Inbetween Phase and comes to the forefront once identities are revealed during the Reality Phase. Whether it’s a Terror tracking down an Innocent or survivors cornering an exposed Infected, the chase is where tension peaks. This patch focuses on refining this crucial element of gameplay.

We have a lot more to come here, and look forward to sharing more with you in an upcoming livestream!

[h1]What’s Changing?[/h1]

[h2]Millhaven Asylum[/h2]
Two new pathways open, creating fresh flanking routes and mobility around the largest map in Deceit 2.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43698514/370141fc358c8eb7f502b4e55be482587d2b7f00.png[/img]

[h2]Blackthorne Manor[/h2] 
A newly fractured wall shifts movement possibilities for those in need.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43698514/70975b3d20883daf1ea38e1b3d832487ee6205a9.png[/img]

[h3]Faster Movement[/h3]
All characters receive a speed boost, ensuring tighter pacing and less camping.

[h2]Terror Reworks[/h2]
[h3]Experiment[/h3]
Increased the number of eyes on the Circus map to prevent the Experiment being weakened.

[h3]Werewolf[/h3]
Howl now marks players with blood trails, leaving a lasting scent to track. Portal wolves have been removed to streamline the focus on hunting. Sanity drain now scales with distance—if you hear the howl, you’ll feel it—reinforcing the Werewolf’s presence as a relentless predator.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43698514/7f496de4967aece6c013f59b4af33db41be5a9a6.gif[/img]

[h3]Clown[/h3]
Can teleport to its trap, simplifying its utility. Banana collection speeds increased, and the 'Go Bananas' duration reduced for better balance.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43698514/babcc7643ed5e919aeafbd62acbe8f6fedccfff3.gif[/img]

[h3]Vampire[/h3]
No significant changes—just a fix to prevent bats from getting stuck. The Vampire’s strong, high-impact playstyle remains unchanged.

[h3]General[/h3]
All Terror grab widths increased for better close-range effectiveness

[h2]Weak Points [/h2]
[*] Weak Points now take longer to activate and are easier to detect.

[h2]Item Changes[/h2]
[*] [b]The Return Pad:[/b] Now indestructible—provides a cold trail to counter the Werewolf’s scent ability.
[*] [b]Player Tracker:[/b] Targeting distance increased (200 → 1500)—more useful mid-chase.

Your choices shape the shadows. We’ll be monitoring player feedback, refining where necessary.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43698514/253f6d4b660285c3b19c8dc60ee8b8f016be7eb6.png[/img]

[h1]Limited-Time Temptation – Store & Daily Deals[/h1]

A fresh wave of temptation has arrived.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43698514/89c05a9c473bffbb964c3b01445e94ac4e0477b6.png[/img]

Lisa’s long-awaited [b]Vampire Hunter Skin[/b] is now available in the store—a striking new look for those who wish to stand against the darkness. You asked for it, and now it’s yours to claim. But will you wield it as a force of justice, or let it pull you into the abyss?

Meanwhile, we’re bringing back highly requested skins for a limited time. To kick things off, the [b]Vampire Hunter Pistol[/b] and [b]Alex’s Vampire Hunter Skin[/b] will make a fleeting appearance over the coming days. When they vanish, they may not return.

Power is within reach—but every choice has its price.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43698514/253f6d4b660285c3b19c8dc60ee8b8f016be7eb6.png[/img]

[h2]Engine Upgrade[/h2]

We've upgraded to Unreal Engine 5.5, delivering core optimizations and fixes that improve overall performance and stability. While DLSS is temporarily unavailable due to plugin compatibility, it will be re-added once the plugin is updated. In the meantime, players can still benefit from FSR for enhanced graphics.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43698514/253f6d4b660285c3b19c8dc60ee8b8f016be7eb6.png[/img]

The board shifts. The pieces move. The game remains.

And you?

You are simply [b]playing your part.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43698514/253f6d4b660285c3b19c8dc60ee8b8f016be7eb6.png[/img]

[h2]Patch Notes[/h2]

[h3]Misc.[/h3]
[list]
[*] Peddler Shop interaction distance increased from 5m to 10m.
[*] Allows players to buy items on “the fly” more quickly.
[*] The volume of voice chat at night has been slightly increased.
[*] Added new chant audio during voting.
[*] Updated the Inquisitor role icon.
[*] Improved in-between ghost models.
[*] Manor Stone Pistol has been visually improved.
[*] Updated lighting on Millhaven.
[*] Rift Portals have been visually improved.
[*] Improved the sounds of Butler and Confession Booth.
[*] Added your current role information to the Q menu.
[*] Removed soft-fail from Pinboard, Locked Doors and Grandfather Clock objectives.
[*] Added Kitchen Door Task.
[/list]

[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] [FIXED] Werewolf skillcheck mechanics drains sanity inconsistently.
[*] [FIXED] Rachel’s Cavewoman hair is visible in first person.
[*] [FIXED] The Flute emote doesn’t loop properly.
[*] [FIXED] Vampire male drop animation is using a placeholder.
[*] [FIXED] Beck’s hair occasionally disappears.
[*] [FIXED] Gas grenade applies to terrors.
[*] [FIXED] Role ability keybind is not showing after a cooldown.
[*] [FIXED] Being able to jump when Ball & Chained.
[*] [FIXED] Occasionally after watching a player activate a blood altar in spectate, their hand would be stuck in the air.
[*] [FIXED] Occasionally characters will play a “struggle” or “low sanity” sound after the night has ended.
[*] [FIXED] Clicking on your own nametag will show player options.
[*] [FIXED] Soulbound being able to open the selector wheel when a partner was already selected.
[*] [FIXED] Occasionally terrors are being stuck in grab animation for spectators.
[*] [FIXED] When changing item slots in the Peddler shop, if you are holding one of the items of interest, it would be unequipped, but still show as selected in the inventory.
[*] [FIXED] Handcuffs animation still playing when the player is down.
[*] [FIXED] Time-based mutations not applying after Silence mutation was applied.
[*] [FIXED] Decoy having outdated in-between ghost model.
[*] [FIXED] Ritual visuals not spawning for instant deaths.
[*] [FIXED] Dart Pistol not playing the magazine out or load sounds.
[*] [FIXED] Being able to get stuck on Rotating Doors if grabbed.
[*] [FIXED] Black screen after night or day transition.
[*] [FIXED] Vampire bat occasionally getting stuck when looking for a player.
[*] [FIXED] There are various spots that are unintentionally accessible.

notes.title: Update 6.1 - The Lunar Event
notes.content:
Beneath the crimson glow of a rising lunar tide, a new chapter unfolds. What you perceive as celebration is but another cycle of my design, a fleeting respite before the inevitable descent. Welcome to Update 6.1—where festivity dances hand-in-hand with dread, and every shimmer of hope comes with a shadow.

[hr][/hr]

[h2]The Lunar Event: Fragments of Fortune[/h2]  
From [b]January 16th to February 6th[/b], the Lunar Event casts its glow over the Ritual. This fleeting moment offers rewards cloaked in opportunity and fraught with cost.  
[list]  
[*][b]Item 1:[/b] 10 Event Points  
[*][b]Item 2:[/b] 20 Event Points  
[*][b]Item 3:[/b] 30 Event Points  
[*][b]Item 4:[/b] 40 Event Points  
[*][b]Item 5:[/b] 50 Event Points  
[/list]  
Gather these with haste to claim what you can before time slips away.

[hr][/hr]

[h2]Lunar Event Items[/h2]  
The Lunar Event unveils a collection of skins that embody the celebration’s eerie allure, each more captivating and sinister than the last:  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43698514/c8820e9a07046fa3e316996a7804e3fcd6183946.png[/img]

[list]  
[*][b]Snake Torch:[/b] A serpentine artifact ablaze with crimson and gold scales, symbolizing the duality of guidance and peril.  
[*][b]Snake Sticker:[/b] A vibrant and mesmerizing design of two interwoven serpents, their colorful scales shimmering with an almost hypnotic allure.  
[*][b]Loading Screen:[/b] A breathtaking visual of a colossal dragon coiling through ancient temple ruins, bathed in fiery hues and lunar light.  
[*][b]Chopstick Sanity Serum:[/b] An ornate vial of swirling liquid madness, adorned with intricate chopsticks.  
[*][b]Fortune Invisibility Medallion:[/b] A deceptively playful charm, its golden surface hiding cryptic truths that echo faintly as you wield its power.  
[*][b]Vespal Snakebite:[/b] A skin that transforms the wearer into a scaled terror with crimson fangs and sleek armor.  
[/list]  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43698514/095aa302cab872b400453fb65cd6e3cc494931f7.png[/img]

Throughout the event, the store will unveil [b]daily deals[/b]—limited-time opportunities to test your resolve. Will you embrace the madness and claim these treasures, or let them slip into the shadows?  

The Lunar tide has left its mark on the world. Every corner of the [b]Maps and Menus[/b] now reflects the event’s eerie influence. Explore the transformed landscapes and uncover the secrets they hold within.

[hr][/hr]

[h2]Skill Check System: A Test of Will[/h2]  
The Lunar Event introduces a new layer of challenge—the [b]Skill Check System[/b]. Each Terror now employs a unique skillcheck when executing their victims. Survival depends on your ability to perform these skillchecks correctly and escape before your Sanity is entirely drained.  

[list]  
[*][b]Experiment:[/b] Time your efforts precisely to counter the Experiment’s grasp. Interact at the right moment along the bar to break free.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43698514/2ea1ddee6082ed052a7c2a0c0e0f08435183f6f7.gif[/img]

[*][b]Werewolf:[/b] Struggle against raw ferocity as you face the Werewolf. Interact continuously to fill the bar and escape its clutches.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43698514/3938cb406a05d19123ebd0928629affd525abacc.gif[/img]

[*][b]Vampire:[/b] Control your heartbeat as the Vampire sinks its fangs. Interact on each beat along the bar to resist and break free.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43698514/89c95c5b9f5f595b21c4719509694f4ee7eb7636.gif[/img]

[*][b]Clown:[/b] Match the erratic mood swings of the Clown. Interact at the right moments to swing back and forth along the bar and escape its chaotic grasp.   

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43698514/fe4ad1adf4c1490c3d63c7951752957dd2473bdf.gif[/img]
[/list] 

Your skill and focus will determine your survival. Fail, and the Terrors will take everything. Succeed, and you may live to fight another day—at least until the next encounter.

[hr][/hr]

[h2]Golden Dragon: Wyrtorn Skin[/h2]  
Emerging from the depths of ancient legend, the Golden Dragon Wolf skin combines elegance with primal ferocity. Its bronze-toned scales shimmer with a metallic sheen, reflecting its mystique and strength. Available in the Store for [b]600 Shillings[/b], this skin is more than an aesthetic choice—it’s a symbol of untamed power.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43698514/c15edea16d366ea2b1d60c316559fdda9e6e6c45.png[/img]

[hr][/hr]

[h2]New Store Item: Legendary Key Bundles[/h2]  
New Key Bundles have been added to the consumables section of the store for those seeking treasures from past cycles. Each bundle contains five keys, unlocking three cosmetics per key:  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43698514/9208872a649174b327c621651436420ee0af44fa.png[/img]

[list]  
[*][b]Legendary Bundle:[/b] 4,500 Shillings  
[*][b]Rare Bundle:[/b] 2,000 Shillings  
[*][b]Uncommon Bundle:[/b] 1,000 Shillings  
[*][b]Common Bundle:[/b] 500 Shillings  
[/list]  

This is a [b]one-time deal[/b] and will disappear once activated.

[hr][/hr]

You see, every step you take in this celebration leads deeper into the tapestry of inevitability. The Lunar Event is a moment of opportunity—and a reminder. Resistance is futile.

[b]See you in the Ritual![/b]

[hr][/hr]

[h3][b]Improvements[/b][/h3]

[list]
[*] Execution skillchecks have been added for each terror.
[*] The volume of voice chat at night has been slightly increased.
[*] The Season Tab on the menu has been visually reworked.
[*] The Battlehardened Werewolf skin has been visually improved.
[*] Weakpoints are now outlined to the infected when on.
[*] The feedback effect on tannoy audio has been reduced.
[*] The Main Menu has been optimised.
[/list]

[h3][b]Fixes[/b][/h3]

[list]
[*] [FIXED] Beck’s hair occasionally disappears.
[*] [FIXED] There is a visual issue with Arcane Beck’s glasses.
[*] [FIXED] The Seer’s ability is not outlining players.
[*] [FIXED] The phone task on the Asylum is hard to see.
[*] [FIXED] The game can enter an unplayable state if you are grabbed by a terror whilst emoting.
[*] [FIXED] The Phantom doesn’t consistently die if the key is taken whilst they’re being voted on.
[*] [FIXED] The Sanity Serum plays its use sound on equip.
[*] [FIXED] The Flute emote doesn’t loop properly.
[*] [FIXED] There are various spots that are unintentionally accessible.
[/list]

notes.content:

notes.title: Update 5.3 - The Christmas Event
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43698514/02572727c4dd5e58c988e20594b03ecf790ecab9.png[/img]

Subjects, the season of giving has arrived… and it’s utterly revolting.

What’s this? [b]Update 5.3 brings with it the Christmas Event[/b], a sickening spectacle of cheer and goodwill that even the Inbetween couldn’t escape. The Game Master, however, finds this seasonal nonsense a vile intrusion into the Ritual—but remember: what The Game Master gives, he can also take away.

[h2]Christmas Has Taken Over[/h2]
The main menu drips with festive charm, and my Ritual Sites are defiled with garish lights, gaudy decorations, and a chilling frost. Twinkling lights might try to warm your heart, but they won’t save you from the cold grip of betrayal.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43698514/09d0e62e0163df006042cc2ff13012d4979ebc11.png[/img]

[h2]The Christmas Event – A Necessary Evil[/h2]
I’ll allow you a moment of frivolity—if only to watch you squabble over scraps. From 12th December to 9th January, the Christmas Event offers festive rewards for treachery.
Every item collected from the Peddler now earns Event Points, a new Event Currency to fuel your desperation:

[b]Item 1[/b]: 10 Event Points
[b]Item 2[/b]: 20 Event Points
[b]Item 3[/b]: 30 Event Points
[b]Item 4[/b]: 40 Event Points
[b]Item 5[/b]: 50 Event Points

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43698514/a1d84f35faaf7e560a50af911c681cdeb8325343.png[/img]
That’s a possible 150 Points per game—if you make it out alive. If you are impatient, then double your haul with the power of Blessings, or speed up your acquisitions with Shillings to bask in your spoils even sooner. 

[h2]Tasks Twisted Further[/h2]
I’ve taken it upon myself to tangle your precious tasks in even darker threads. More layers of chaos, more ways to falter—because why should you have it easy?

Burn the Skeleton: Old bones roasting on an open fire…

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43698514/905f7b043813dd26ba6324ddeff14f9a866eff3d.gif[/img]

Unlock the Master Chest: Dig into its depths—will you find treasures or regrets?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43698514/e65e7d8cc6e5340afcb7bc080746768c53a45c9b.gif[/img]

[h2]Snow Krampus Joins the Shop[/h2]

The Special Edition Snow Krampus Skin is now lurking in the store, ready to bring a chill to the festivities. For those who prefer terror over tinsel, this is your chance to dress the part and show the world that not every gift is meant to delight. Available from 12th December to 9th January.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43698514/7a5db801d3473826745e9d8314dbdc60bc1156ad.png[/img]
[h2]New Year Event – A Celebration of Sacrifice[/h2]
As the holidays roll on, the Christmas Event takes a sinister turn to mark the New Year. From 26th December to 9th January, new exclusive cosmetics will join the festive offerings, all obtainable through gameplay—if you’re bold (or foolish) enough to commit yourself to the Ritual.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43698514/fe66e8f4dcea7a382baf827b077237f6d47cb6ed.png[/img]

Every action you take during the Christmas Event will continue to earn Event Points, which can then be used to unlock these New Year exclusives. But tread carefully—time is fleeting, and these items will vanish as quickly as the year itself.

Curious about what’s in store? Keep a watchful eye on our socials as we get closer…

Subjects, the Christmas Event update is live. Revel in the charade of giving, scramble for your rewards, and remember—kindness is the greatest lie of all.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43698514/ea939b70e42b3d8c3365541ee1c3c633c5331af0.png[/img]
[b]Happy Holidays, if you must. See you in the Ritual![/b]

[h2]Patch Notes[/h2]
[h3]Terror Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Morgus’ Jack in the Box now stacks up to 3, and Morgus starts each inbetween with 3 boxes to place.
[*] Morgus’ Jack in the Box’s animation now lasts slightly longer, and has been repositioned to see more of the monkey. The trap slowdown duration has been changed from 1 to 0.875.
[*] Morgus’ music has generally had its volume decreased.
[*] New audio has been added to Morgus picking up bananas.
[*] Wyrton now only spawn wolves when using the howl ability - each ability activation spawns one wolf, up to a cap of 4 per Wyrton. Howl cooldown reduced from 15 to 10 seconds.
