notes.title: Update 5.2 - Daily Rewards
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43698514/6f4922dc8aa6aa8895737bf8c539c78bdfd8f59f.png[/img]

[b]Subjects,[/b]
Christmas has arrived early, but not in the way you might expect. This update has been shaped by your suggestions, but as the saying goes, be careful what you wish for… A brand new update lies ahead, just waiting for you to unwrap the horrors within.

For the impatient, our Christmas Event will begin on December 12th. 

[h3]Daily Rewards Overview[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43698514/2c520a28a08aab50fb5bce9b13696f1afc47f9b8.png[/img]
Separate from the Christmas festivities, the long awaited Daily Rewards have arrived, offering you the chance to claim valuable gifts. Thanks to your feedback about Crypt Keys, we’ve ensured all players can now access Crypt keys and other rewards. Log in for 20 days in any given calendar month to secure your rewards.

This system resets monthly, so don’t let these opportunities slip through your fingers. Step into the Ritual, open the door, and let the rewards come to you... before time runs out.

[h3]Mutations Breakdown[/h3]
The balance of power has shifted. Four new Mutations have been unleashed, to allow for even more exciting gameplay. These new abilities are earned by levelling up as the Infected.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43698514/f6f7ef64386eee198f955f9ac5060db5b9742fea.png[/img]
[b]Closed[/b]
The Peddler’s shop locks its doors for 30 seconds, silencing your cries for aid. No bargains. No deals. Only silence.

[b]Drained[/b]
For the next 10 seconds, every soul you collect is stolen. Your hard-earned progress snatched away.

[b]Blockage[/b]
Portals seal shut for 20 seconds, trapping you in the chaos of the Inbetween. There is no escape. 

[b]Paralyze[/b]
For 2.5 seconds, the Infected tighten their grip on reality, freezing everyone in place. Your escape halts, leaving you as easy prey.

We’ve also refined how Mutations spawn, incorporating your feedback—explore the Patch Notes for full details.

[h3]Tasks Reworked[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43698514/8e26e6cfa70eab6f334ce7af8a66a729da0da5a0.png[/img]
Tasks have been reimagined to challenge both your wits and your nerve. Familiar tasks now twist with added complexity, while new challenges emerge to keep you guessing.
This is just the beginning. The Ritual evolves with each passing day—stay vigilant.

[h3]New UI Wheels Changes[/h3]
Your pleas have been heard: the radial menus have all been reworked into a more cohesive experience ensuring that every interaction is intuitive and responsive.

[h3]Update 5.3 - Coming Soon[/h3]

The shadows grow as Update 5.3 approaches. A newly designed Christmas Event, bringing Christmas-themed cosmetics. These aren’t simple trinkets though, they are gifts born of nightmares, waiting to be claimed

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43698514/314e24678d9f38518385e80aa63b2aeb9ff3666d.png[/img]

Every reward can be earned [b]for free[/b] through the event.

The game is set. The Inbetween calls. [b]See you in the Ritual.[/b]

[h3]Improvements[/h3]
[list]
[*] Heartbeat sounds ramp up faster the closer you are to a Terror.
[*] A message and particle effect is now triggered when trying to teleport to a destroyed return pad.

[*] The following UIs have been updated:
[list]
[*] Inventory and Shop tiles
[*] Terror abilities
[*] Buff/debuff bar
[/list]
[*] Four new mutations have been added into game, mutations are now split into 2 tiers, where Tier 1 are considered stronger than Tier 2. Currently, the T1 Mutations are: Turbulence, Soul Swap and Clarity. How Mutations now spawn: In the first Reality Phase 1x T1 Mutation + 2x T2 Mutations, in the second Reality Phase 1x T1 Mutation + 2x T2 Mutations, and in the third Reality Phase 1x T1 Mutation.
[*] The tannoy speaker audio has been tweaked to be less grating.
[*] The GM’s voicelines now duck in volume when players are using voice chat.
[*] All selector wheels now use a consistent style.
[*] Audio is no longer muffled when opening a selector wheel.
[*] The Sanity Serum sanity increase is now applied earlier in the animation.
[*] Major Event popups no longer show whilst you’re dying.
[*] Player names have been removed from the Oracle UI.
[*] Audio improvements have been made to the banishing ritual.
[*] The GM’s game result announcement now triggers on the loading screen, before the Game Summary sequence begins.
[*] Navigating to the store now takes you directly to the tab or item.
[*] Destroyed cameras now have a broken electrical box.
[*] If you don’t have enough shillings, the purchase item button on the store now takes you to the purchase shillings screen.
[*] The time it takes for downed players to move to the center of their banishing ritual has been decreased.
[*] The Circle around your teammate’s portrait now shows the correct colour.
[*] The SoulStrike cooldown now pauses during the Inbetween.
[*] The logos on the banners during the Game Summary sequence have been updated.
[*] Translations have been updated - thank you to our community translators.
[/list]
[h3]Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] [FIXED] Items don’t hide properly whilst using the invisibility medallion.

notes.title: Season 5 - Circus of Secrets
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43698514/98135f9cbd51da1b9e308533cdf3b954ae89091a.png[/img]
[h2][b]Subjects,[/b][/h2]

The curtains have parted open once again, ushering in [i]Season 5: Circus of Secrets[/i]. It’s showtime, and your role in this twisted carnival of terrors awaits. The Game Master has prepared an array of performances that will challenge you all. 

[h2]New Season Pass 🎟️[/h2]
Prepare yourself, for the Season 5 Pass is a ticket to thrills and chills! Only the most daring Subjects will make it through every fiendish prize we’ve set in place.

[h2]Upgrade with the Premium Bundle 💎[/h2]
The Premium Bundle isn’t just a choice; it’s a lifeline. It includes:

[list]
[*] Premium Pass: Access every last shred of exclusive content in Season 5.
[*] 30,000 Season XP: Fast-track your suffering and dominate the weak.
[*] 4 Crypt Keys (One of each rarity): Unlock Crypts, uncover the unimaginable, and lose a piece of your sanity each time.
[/list]
[h2]Exclusive Skins & Items:[/h2]
Step up to the ring and feast your eyes on the dark treasures of the Season Pass:

[list]
[*] Ringmistress Lisa: Unleash a commanding presence that only Lisa, the Ringmistress herself, can embody—an outfit fit for the one who rules the Circus of Secrets.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43698514/40be4352842d4a03f3f695334e8fdca76dedbfd2.png[/img]

[*] Fart Bomb & Extreme Fart Bomb: Not for the faint of heart. These gas grenades carry a putrid punch, clouding the air with a stench that will halt Subjects in their tracks.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43698514/a228c06ab165b66a32a5392d0abf9c79e72fab64.gif[/img]

[*] Madame Priya & Madame Murder: Elegance with a deadly edge. Priya’s transformation as Madame brings a refined menace, with Murder adding an even darker twist.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43698514/3578dc24684e1a817541752965405246ef7758cf.png[/img]

[*] Oracle Beck & Oracle Power: Cloak yourself in the mysterious allure of Beck’s Oracle persona, or harness its amplified power—both are tailored for those who seek hidden truths.

[*] Banana & Rotten Banana Smoke Grenades: Light-hearted pranks with deadly impact; these grenades scatter smoke across the Inbetween

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43698514/030f9dc6b3e6dbbdce1c6682f0169b58453b27b7.gif[/img]

[*] Watergun & Clear Watergun (Pistol): A splash of terror wrapped in child’s play—don’t be fooled by their bright colours.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43698514/b97e76d686a1d4e3b79016502f00c57568e775ce.gif[/img]

[*] Cannonball & Cannon Fodder Jak: With Jak’s cannonball-style attire, you’ll bring explosive energy to any encounter

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43698514/cdc4fee0cbeff85ea82bb18d4a1eb8e776e0dcbc.gif[/img]

[*] Cuddly & Forgotten Monkey: A deceptively innocent companion—yet let’s just say this monkey remembers things best left forgotten.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43698514/4864a2bc0a3553f55f0eb3bb7d3c0881008ade52.png[/img]
[/list]
Unlock your way through dark delights like Gems and new Crypt Keys, plus much more. 

[h2]Crypt Changes – New Keys Await 🔑[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43698514/097b8154dcb1bb77bfe8829b5c99ceae3bdc744a.jpg[/img]

Beneath the veil, the Crypts have transformed once again. With Season 5, we’re introducing four distinct Crypt Keys—common, uncommon, rare, and legendary. Existing keys will remain unchanged, but this shift allows us to eliminate games of chance between rarities. Randomised Crypt rarities didn’t feel like the right fit, and now each key has a clear value.

[h2]Arcane Store Additions [/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43698514/dc30ae0764f2079a32e126f47749dd276a985025.gif[/img]

Step into the Arcane Store, where new horrors and twisted wonders await! Unleash the Return Pad—a relic that bends the very fabric of time—and cloak yourself in the Vampire Skin, a look that turns you into an unholy predator of the night. With veins crackling in energy and a form barely holding together, this transformation is perfect for those midnight hunts where terror is your only ally.

[h2]The Halloween Store – Last Chance 🎃[/h2]

Your final opportunity to claim the treasures of the Halloween Store is next week. From darkly enchanting skins to the iconic loading screen, seize them while you still can, before they vanish into the Inbetween.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43698514/3c59d581d9e8891e1b0c12dcab6af40023c66760.png[/img]

[h2]The Clown Pack[/h2]
To enjoy the full madness of Season 5, make sure you’ve unlocked the [url=https://www.worldmakers.com/clown-pack-social]CLOWN Pack[/url]!

With Morgus the twisted jester, wield terrifying powers, unlock the vengeful Phantom, and disorient your foes with the Blindfold. Embrace the chaos and step into the Circus of Secrets—laughter and screams await. 🎪

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43698514/8fd6e907c50414c177fbfb786398476e08ca2b91.png[/img]

[h3][b]Improvements[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] The lighting on the Menu has been reworked.

notes.title: Update 4.4 - Halloween
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43698514/c78e9f40df641932d5349259b02f1be06d99a44c.png[/img]

[h2] Subjects, [/h2]
As Halloween creeps closer, we've been brewing up a cauldron of updates, blending fresh visuals with powerful role buffs. Our top priority, however, has been squashing bugs and fine-tuning the game’s performance—and we'll keep at it.

With Season 4 drawing to a close next week, it’s time to delve into the dark secrets of what’s in store for you.

[h2] Halloween Store Update [/h2]
The Halloween store is now live, including three brand-new skins to haunt the Ritual. These seasonal skins will vanish soon, so seize the chance to claim them before they disappear. We’ve also given the Circus a Halloween makeover, so be on the lookout for the seasonal changes.

In addition, everyone will receive a special Halloween loading screen for free! Don’t miss out on this gift—head over to the store and claim your treat.

[h2] Blood Altar Visual Rework [/h2]
The Blood Altar has undergone a complete visual transformation. Prepare for a whole new look when making your sacrifices to the dark forces that govern the Inbetween.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43698514/820164977ef49f93fe8d0041b571a2ec06c79f87.png[/img]
[h2] Role Changes [/h2]
We’ve heard your feedback and reviewed the data, leading to impactful changes that will keep the roles dynamic and balanced. Here’s a closer look at the key updates:

[b]Chemist[/b]
[list]
[*] The Inbetween transition will no longer trigger when players are poisoned, allowing for a smoother experience.
[*] When an infected player is eliminated, the cooldown for your next poison stack is reduced by 25% of its initial cooldown, ensuring you can return to the fray swiftly.
[*] A green smoke particle effect now lingers on players succumbing to the Chemist's poison, providing clearer visual feedback.
[/list]
[b]Soulbound[/b]
[list]
[*] The originally assigned Soulbound is now the Soulbound Alpha, taking on a pivotal role in gameplay.
[*] New Ability: [b]Soulstrike[/b] – When both Soulbound partners are near a downed player, the Alpha can activate this ability to instantly banish the downed player through a zap tether from the Soulbound partner. This ability is unlocked once your partner is chosen.
[/list]

With these changes and more to come, we’re eager to see how you adapt your strategies as we approach the final week of Season 4. Season 5 is on the horizon, so grab your ticket to the Circus of Secrets now...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43698514/3079e3884c18bf865fc32bae504642cefdf9e9c8.png[/img]

[hr][/hr]

[h2] Improvements [/h2]

[list]
[*] Infected mimics now use the terror & terror skin of the infected they copied.
[*] The Seer’s ability will now only cancel on hold if you release the button/key after the full effect has appeared.
[*] Terrors are now Exhausted for 5 seconds when de-transforming, preventing them from vaulting, using portals, traversing cracks, re-transforming, and sprinting.
[*] The Cursed can now sabotage the generator (which can only be sabotaged once per game). All players will know which team caused the sabotage.
[*] Your Infected teammate’s portrait now shows their terror when transformed.
[*] Terrors can now destroy CCTV Cameras, Tannoys & Return Pads when in Terror form.
[*] The hit detection of punching has been improved.
[*] Terrors now get white directional hit indicators when taking light damage.
[*] Controller vibrations have been added for heartbeats & when getting grabbed by a Terror.
[*] Items with a charge now show their remaining charge percentage in the inventory (Heat Goggles, The Mask, Invisibility Medallion).
[*] A photosensitivity warning has been added when you first play the game.
[*] The Clown’s screen effect has been visually tweaked.
[*] A message now appears informing you that your Sanity is full when trying to use the Sanity Serum at full Sanity.
[*] The Cursed icon has been updated to resemble the old one more closely.
[*] A ‘mute all’ button has been added to the mute player menu.
[*] Accolade ranks now display during the Game Summary.
[*] Terror keybinds can now be re-bound.
[*] Rides within the Circus now only play music when they’re actually moving.
[*] Various optimisations & lighting improvements have been made.
[*] Localisation has been updated - thank you to our volunteers.
[/list]

[h2] Fixes [/h2]

[list]
[*] [FIXED] The Vampire’s bat can occasionally get stuck on the Circus map.
[*] [FIXED] When two players are downed, the vote required to eliminate the second player doesn’t reduce when the first player is eliminated.
[*] [FIXED] The Phantom can see a “Banished” message when someone else is killed at the same time it does to last stand.
[*] [FIXED] Eyes and Wolves can deal sanity damage during the end of the Inbetween.
[*] [FIXED] Handcuffs don’t apply when handcuffing someone who is vaulting.
[*] [FIXED] Handcuffing someone repairing the generator doesn’t stop them from repairing it.
[*] [FIXED] The bag scanner doesn’t support certain languages.
[*] [FIXED] The Invisibility Medallion turns the screen white, causing it to be very hard to see.
[*] [FIXED] Activating the return pad can sometimes not play the teleporting sound.
[*] [FIXED] Occasionally, players can still talk to alive players after dying.
[*] [FIXED] Occasionally, when grabbing a player as a Terror as the night ends, the player you grab can spawn next to you.
[*] [FIXED] Players can use items on other players as the night ends.
[*] [FIXED] Players can get stuck in a crack when dropped by a Terror.
[*] [FIXED] Occasionally, you cannot navigate to players at the bottom of the report screen if they’re on a different platform to you.
[*] [FIXED] Multiple “Ritual Collapsing” audio can play if multiple doors are opening.
[*] [FIXED] Various unintended map spots are accessible.
[*] [FIXED] You can grab your Terror partner whilst they are transforming.
[*] [FIXED] When destroying a crack at the end of the Inbetween, you can occasionally not respawn.
[/list]
[hr][/hr]

notes.title: Update 4.3 - Optimisation & Bug Fixes
notes.content:
[b]Subjects,[/b]

Patch 4.3 has arrived, dragging with it a fresh wave of sinister improvements and critical fixes. Study the changes well, for they may decide whether you escape or fall victim to the darkness that awaits.

[h2]Improvements[/h2]

[list]

notes.title: Update 4.2 - The Clown Pack & Circus Ritual Site
notes.content:
[h1]Step Right Up! The Circus Comes to Town![/h1]

Subjects,

Roll up, roll up! The Circus has come to town, and it brings with it a host of nightmares. With Update 4.2, chaos abounds as Morgus, the deranged clown unleashes his twisted revelry. Brace yourself for the madness of the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3238110/Deceit_2__Clown_Pack/]Clown Pack[/url] and venture into the circus ring of our brand new map, Cirque du Solara.

[h2]Unleash Morgus[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43698514/deaa8b964f04426c0d96df8b348f65e40e9d100c.png[/img]
Once the bright star of an 18th-century travelling circus, Morgus was renowned and adored for his antics. But when the cultists came, they dragged the circus into darkness and cast Morgus into the Inbetween. His mind, once full of playful tricks, was shattered and warped by the realm's corruption. What remains is a twisted reflection: yearning for the joyous laughter he once brought, but only finding screams and horror.

The Game Master has granted Morgus a new home — where terror is the name of the game, and Morgus’s longing for laughter will haunt your nightmares.

[h2]Morgus’s Abilities[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43698514/be8e22f77913e0d0deaade3de0d7a9bca12e668b.jpg[/img]

[b]Banana Bar:[/b] Track Morgus’s emotional state with the Banana Bar, which influences his behaviour and speed:

[list]
[*] 0% to 33%: Sad and slow (90% of the Experiment's speed).  
[*] 33% to 66%: Neutral and steady (100% speed).  
[*] 66% to 100%: Playful and fast (110% speed).  
[/list]
Morgus starts off despondent but becomes more playful as he collects bananas around the Ritual Site. Being dazed will reset the Banana Bar, but once it hits 100%, he reaches his peak of wild unpredictability, amplifying his erratic nature and desire to interact with subjects.

[b]Go Bananas:[/b] When the Banana Bar hits 100%, unleash Go Bananas for 15 seconds of chaos:
[list]
[*] Speed: Moves at a speed equal to the Experiment’s sprint speed.  
[*] Strength: Gains immunity to light damage.  
[*] Wall Destruction: Can smash through barriers with ease.  
[/list]
When this state ends, the Banana Bar resets to 0%.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43698514/9c5c757c6daf631f4c1ac3dae7fce48bceb8580b.jpg[/img]

[b]Hysterical:[/b] Grip your victim and unleash a relentless laugh that drains their sanity, instilling terror and leading to their eventual demise. Morgus’s obliviousness to his strength makes his playful grip lethal.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43698514/0140e8ffab1fc0391bfd941f6f07a768cbf7c357.jpg[/img]
[b]Jack-in-the-box:[/b] Deploy a Jack-in-the-box trap:

[list]
[*] Activation: Triggers a scare, draining sanity, slowing the victim, and marking them for the Infected.  
[*] Destruction: Can be destroyed by light or will vanish when the Inbetween ends.  
[/list]
Step up and buy Morgus from the in-game shop, but remember, he doesn’t perform for free.

[h2]New Curse: The Phantom[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43698514/426c74149bda50b5e3879f30984c91518161f404.png[/img]
The night is far from over! When banished by vote, the Phantom refuses to be silenced. Instead, they return as a Menace, cloaked in shadow and deceit. Armed with a one-shot weapon, they rise to unleash chaos on the unsuspecting. Now available in the in-game shop!

[h2]New Item: The Blindfold[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43698514/4f669564009d1ca72240246f70031e3d6d488162.png[/img]
Shroud your enemies in darkness with the Blindfold. This sinister item blinds victims, leaving them to stumble in confusion and fear, ripe for your wicked plans. Available exclusively with the DLC!

[h2]New Ritual Site: Cirque du Solara[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43698514/81a6887ab30860731ca322ad336c2583893985c8.png[/img]
Step right up to the haunting grounds of the infamous Solara sisters’ travelling circus. Once filled with joy, it now stands only as a cursed playground for Morgus, where the line between entertainment and terror blurs. Navigate through eerie tents, evade sinister traps, and uncover the dark secrets lurking in the shadows of this macabre carnival.

Cirque du Solara introduces two new mechanics that will test your wits and resolve:

[b]The Oracle (Suspicion System):[/b] The Oracle’s gaze never wavers, her silent scrutiny unnerving. But she offers more than observation—she speaks. Deep within her tent of wonders, you may approach her with burning questions. She can reveal unsettling truths like, “How many are Infected?” or “Which innocent roles are among you?” If you dare, she might even answer, “Is everyone here on the same team?” These are just a few of the questions she can answer… but many more await. Remember, knowledge comes at a price—are you willing to pay it?

[b]Ferris Wheel (Sabotage System):[/b] The Infected can sabotage the Ferris Wheel motor, bringing it to a halt. The innocents must gather scattered parts and bring them back to the Ferris Wheel to get it moving again. Will you work together, or will chaos reign while you scramble to restore the Wheel before it’s too late?

*The map is free for all players.

[h2]Prepare for Season 5 - The Circus of Secrets[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43698514/5b8c074feb28c5468f0854cec3e9ea4e2b35dd4f.jpg[/img]

But wait, there’s more to quench your thirst for terror. Season 5 looms on the horizon, set to launch at the end of the month. This chilling chapter will be dedicated to the new map and the Clown Pack, plunging you deeper into the abyss of dread and despair. 

[h2]Embrace the Madness[/h2]

The Inbetween has undergone a significant overhaul, transforming from its previously dark atmosphere to a reimagined fog-filled Ritual. Extensive work has gone into making it more immersive and exhilarating, creating a new experience for players.

With these exciting updates comes the Clown Pack. Whether you embrace Morgus, wield the Phantom's power, or plunge your foes into confusion with the Blindfold, this update promises a carnival of horrors like no other. The stakes have never been higher, and the thrills have never been more torturous.

See you in the Ritual, Subjects! Let the games begin!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43698514/1399eb96cd862fd2d4933a399dd4400a6fafef31.jpg[/img]
[h2]Patch Notes[/h2]

[list]
[*]Both the Experiment & Clown now show “Immune” above their head when they are immune to light damage.  
[*]A ‘Roles’ tab has been added to the menu - where you can see all of the roles in the game and their abilities.  
[*]The Experiment now has an animation when destroying a wall crack.  
[*]The ‘Ascension’ tab on the menu has been visually reworked.  
[*]Significant amount of optimisation work across a large number of assets.  
[*]Lighting has been substantially reworked to improve both look, feel, and optimisation.  
[*]‘Lollipop’ Hammer of Mending, ‘Candy’ Experiment, ‘Sweetheart’ Rachel, and ‘Sweet Enough’ Chang are now available in the in-game store.  
[*]A new default loading screen has been added for Cirque du Solara.  
[*]Accolades have been added for Cirque du Solara, Clown, The Blindfold, and The Phantom.  
[*] Your team’s colour now shows on your implant at the beginning of the game.  
[*] Your implant now shows your team colour when using second sight.  
[*]Your assigned role now shows at the beginning of the game.  
[*]The Game Summary screen now shows the terror name & icon, rather than just ‘Infected’.  
[*]Terror icons now display for both yourself & your terror partner in-game.  
[*]Health/Sanity no longer shows unnecessarily whilst spectating.  
[*]Glossary entries have been added for the Butler & Reactor.  
[*]The Conveyor belt task is no longer usable when in Terror Form.  
[*]Improved the collision on the stairs on the Manor to improve the Werewolf’s mobility.  
[*]The ‘Ready Up’ button has been visually updated on the menu.  
[*]Localisation has been updated throughout the game.  
[*][FIXED] Implant’s ‘soul capture’ pulse does not always work.  
[*][FIXED] Several maps have spots unintended for humans to reach.  
[*][FIXED] The ski mask heat goggles can disappear at certain angles.  
[*][FIXED] Players can carry on dying when the Chemist disconnects.  
[*][FIXED] Handcuffs do not apply to someone who is handcuffed
[/list]

notes.title: Update 4.1 - New Store
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43698514/7169f4903a9d90859e509823b9ed6c3ac8b9ac97.png[/img]

[b]Subjects,[/b]

Your journey has dragged you to the edge of a new and twisted realm. With Season 4’s Update 4.1, we dive deeper Into the Inbetween, and at the heart of this descent lies a fully revamped store.

[h3]A Brand New Store[/h3]
This is no ordinary shop—it’s a gateway to the mysterious and forbidden. The newly reworked Store now features a selection of [b]Featured Deals, Blessings, and Character Skins[/b]. At the center of this new overhaul is the brand-new Arcane Store, where a new currency, Gems, reigns supreme. These elusive Gems can only be spent within this shadowy bazaar, accessible from the [b]Main Menu[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43698514/704b396daf72bb13ae57687e84100d384f7e8f03.png[/img]

[h3]The Daily Offer[/h3]
Every day, a single cosmetic from the Crypt will be unlocked and made globally available for purchase. This fleeting opportunity allows you to claim these coveted treasures before they vanish back into the shadows of the Crypt. Don’t miss your chance to seize these elusive offers each day!

[h3]The Arcane Store[/h3]
Shrouded in mystery and rot, Arcane cosmetics are crafted for those who revel in the darkness of the Ritual. Cloaked in red and purple, they echo the twisted essence of the Inbetween, with slow-moving smoke coiling around them like whispers of decay. Elegant yet sinister patterns intertwine beauty with malevolence, while haunting sound effects complete their otherworldly charm.

[h3]Earning Gems[/h3]
To earn Gems, seek them out as a low chance reward from the Crypt—an esteemed prize for those who dare to explore its depths. If you’ve already collected every Crypt reward, Gems will serve as your consolation prize. Keep an eye out, as Gems will soon be introduced to the Season Pass, offering even more opportunities to acquire them.

[h3]Launch Day Delights[/h3]
At launch, behold these initial Arcane horrors:
[list] 
[*][b]Arcane Core - Loading Screen (animated)[/b]: A gemstone throbbing with dark energy. (1 Gem)
[*][b]Arcane Power - Emote[/b]: Shatter into particles and reassemble with sinister power. (3 Gems)
[*][b]Arcane - Pistol[/b]: A dread-infused version of your standard sidearm. (7 Gems)
[*][b]Arcane - Beck[/b]: A chilling twist on the Arrival skin, imbued with eerie grace. (14 Gems)
[/list]
[h3]Miscellaneous Updates[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Collection Tab UI Rework[/b]: The Collection Tab has been revamped for ease of use.
[*] [b]Enhanced Rendering[/b]: The CCTV Tablet, Camera, and Portals have been sharpened for a clearer, more unsettling view.
[*] [b]Community Translators[/b]: A thank you to our translators for broadening the reach of the Ritual.
[*] [b]Glitch Spots & Bug Fixes[/b]: Numerous bugs and glitches have been vanquished in this update. Your tricks have been exposed, and now, there’s nowhere left to hide.
[/list]
Step into the Store, claim your torment, and immerse yourself in the Arcane. Your survival and conquest await—if you dare to seize them.

[b]See you in the Ritual[/b]

[hr][/hr]

notes.title: Season 4 - Into The Inbetween
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43698514/19ae6834102b1745c688274a38ecaecf0b685204.png[/img][h1]Subjects,[/h1]

I see you've survived long enough to witness another Season. But don't get too comfortable. [b]Season 4[/b] isn't just a game—it's a descent 'Into the Inbetween'. This time, I've drawn from the darkest corners, where nightmares slither in the shadows, waiting to devour the weak.

Get in-game now and face the latest torments I've crafted just for you.

[h2]Ritual Destabilisation & Collapse 💥[/h2]

Following your feedback, the Final Showdown has been removed.

Instead, when only three Subjects remain, the Ritual falters, slipping into Destabilisation. Innocents must still complete Tasks, but they will now slowly start to complete themselves. The Infected will lose their global sight of others. Anyone who is downed is Banished instantly. Tread carefully, for this is the moment where choices matter most.

Then, when the Key is claimed, the Ritual descends into total Collapse. The Inbetween takes hold permanently. Any Cursed left behind are Banished on the spot, purged from this realm. For the Innocent, survival becomes a race. Insert the Key into an exit door, and it will now take time to unlock—its duration dictated by how many remain standing.

But beware—the first Innocent through will secure the victory, but the Ritual does not end. You must escape for yourself if you wish to survive. With danger all around, more exits may be opened, but remember, time is against you.

I eagerly await your thoughts. Share your feedback on our [url=https://linktr.ee/deceit2]social platforms[/url], and I’ll use your input to craft the next dark chapter in our twisted saga.

[h2]Season 4: Into The Inbetween 🌌[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43698514/e95773b4e7664172c7dcb46f1a93e9b91946ac24.png[/img]

Prepare yourselves. The challenges? Gruelling. The rewards? Blood-soaked trinkets, if you're lucky. Surprises? Plenty—none of them pleasant. Think you can survive long enough to claim them? I dare you to try.

[h3]Upgrade with the Premium Bundle 💎[/h3]

The Premium Bundle isn’t just a choice; it’s a lifeline. It includes:
[list]
[*] [b]Premium Pass[/b]: Access every last shred of exclusive content in Season 4. If you can survive long enough to enjoy it.
[*] [b]30,000 Season XP[/b]: Fast-track your suffering and dominate the weak.
[*] [b]3 Crypt Keys[/b]: Unlock Crypts, uncover the unimaginable, and lose a piece of your sanity each time.
[/list]
[h3]Exclusive Skins & Items:[/h3]
Here’s the updated list with the new items included:
[list]
[*] [b]Bloody Hatchet (Hammer of Mending)[/b]: Creation and destruction, intertwined.
[*] [b]Enchanted Priya[/b]: Beauty, veiled in curses.
[*] [b]Broken Rachel[/b]: Fractured beyond repair, like your mind soon will be.
[*] [b]Black Polarzoid (Camera)[/b]: Snap a memory, before you lose them all. I suppose I should give thanks to Brick, Cluedo, Mr Deduction, Prof, JD & Tiego for the concept, at least they did something right.
[*] [b]Cosmic Headset (Earmuffs)[/b]: Protection with a touch of stardust.
[*] [b]Murder Marine Chang[/b]: Drowning enemies not enough for you?
[*] [b]Golden Cat (Ball & Chain)[/b]: For the ones who can't escape.
[*] [b]Chromatic Ski Goggles (Heat Goggles)[/b]: See the world through a kaleidoscope of heat.
[*] [b]Golden Skeletal Werewolf[/b]: The golden touch for a fearsome beast.
[/list]
[h2]The Blessing System 🌟[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43698514/04807af7ba80666e3a92cf73f312b2e9ffab93ef.png[/img]

Before the Ritual begins, Subjects now have the option to invoke a Blessing, which grants all Subjects of the Ritual temporary access to every Terror and Curse without any cost. This provides a chance to explore all available options in the Store.

In addition to this, you’ll earn Double XP as a reward. Blessings can be bought from the Store or received as part of the Premium Pass in Season 4.

Will you be generous enough to share your Blessings?


[h2]Coming Soon...[/h2]

In the upcoming updates:
[list]
[*] [b]Cirque du Solara[/b]: Navigate the remains of the Solara sisters' circus—once joyful, now a nightmare.
[*] [b]The Clown DLC[/b]: My next plans for the Ritual involve The Morgus Terror, a crazy Curse and an eye-popping Item.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43698514/ddcdca85ceb9d3fb6ec8684486e502f82e240028.png[/img]

So, Subjects, dive into Season 4. It's not just a game; it's a fight for your sanity. Welcome to the Inbetween. The Ritual awaits.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43698514/8893c61966bb71c3a809de433753deb24b6ae913.png[/img]

[h3]Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]FIXED[/b]: You can no longer lock yourself in the Shop by purchasing a free item.
[*] [b]FIXED[/b]: The Vampire can no longer detransform while respawning.
[*] [b]FIXED[/b]: Various improvements have been made to enhance the experience of switching between players in spectate mode.
[*] [b]FIXED[/b]: Resolved a black screen issue occurring at the start of a Ritual and during transitions between Reality and Inbetween.
[/list]
[h3]Animations[/h3]
[list]

notes.title: Update 3.4 - Game Watch
notes.content:
[h1]Greetings Subjects,[/h1]

We’re excited to share our new [b]3.4 release[/b], packed with new features driven by your feedback.

[h2]Introducing Game Watch (Beta)[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43698514/3ff95e392d64d38c3b4459971d82c23f1592d181.png[/img]
We’re dedicated to making your gaming experience not only thrilling but also positive and respectful. That’s why we’re excited to introduce [b]Game Watch[/b], a new beta feature that responds to in-game reports by monitoring voice chat in matchmade games and moderating it in real-time.

Game Watch listens to in-game voice chat, and, if you report a player, will immediately analyse what they have said. Using state-of-the-art AI, it will issue each player with a “toxicity score”, and in some cases it will mute certain toxic players for the rest of that game. All reports will then be reviewed by our moderators, who will now have easy access to full transcriptions and a toxicity summary for all reports.

We believe a welcoming community enhances the experience for everyone, and it’s one of the most common areas of feedback we receive. Game Watch is a big step towards this goal. We look forward to receiving your feedback as we continue to review and refine this new system.

[h2]Audio Normalisation[/h2]

To ensure a more balanced audio experience, we’ve added a [b]Voice Normalisation[/b] setting. This feature, enabled by default, equalises player volumes so everyone can be heard clearly without any adjustments on your end.

[h2]Cosmetic Equipping[/h2]

Express yourself with more variety! You can now equip multiple human, terror, and item skins at once. At the start of each game, one of your equipped cosmetics will be randomly selected, keeping your look fresh and unpredictable.

[h2]Terror/Curse Purchasing[/h2]

We’re also introducing in-game purchases for [b]Terrors & Curses[/b]. You can now buy DLC Terrors and Curses directly from the in-game store for 400 and 300 shillings, respectively, adding more ways to gain access to content.

[h2]Game Menu[/h2]

You may notice some small changes to the game menu, such as larger fonts and controller navigation changes. These are a work-in-progress, so expect to see some larger changes in Season 4.

[hr][/hr]

[h2]Patch Notes[/h2]

[h3]Improvements[/h3]

[list]
[*]Outlines no longer fade when sprinting as the Werewolf.
[*]Using items on yourself is no longer instantaneous.
[*]An additional vault has been added to the Manor courtyard fence.
[*]The coughing audio now only triggers on taking gas damage, instead of when you’re low health.
[*]Beck, Jak & Chang have had a visual improvement.
[*]The secret rabbits have been repositioned.
[*]The sorting of the friends list has been improved.
[*]On PC, the Esc key now opens the social panel.
[*]The camera has been repositioned on some tasks to improve the point of view.
[*]The ‘enrage’ music now stops as soon as the escape door is opened, rather than when the game ends.
[*]‘Fail Task’ voice lines now only play on ‘hard’ task failures.
[*]Your teammate’s portrait now turns greyscale when they’re dead.
[*]The ‘being chased’ audio now no longer plays once you’ve been grabbed.
[*]Various soul guide locations & sizes have been tweaked.
[*]Leaving the crypt when being awarded an item/mutation after a game now auto-claims it.
[*]The text size on the main menu header has been increased.
[*]Various new sounds have been added for major event popups.
[*]Various translations have been updated - thank you to our volunteers.
[/list]

[h3]Fixes[/h3]

[list]
[*][FIXED] The ‘Leak’ mutation can no longer be activated during the Final Showdown.
[*][FIXED] Players can no longer reach unintended areas of the maps.
[*][FIXED] Vampires can no longer detransform after being dazed.
[*][FIXED] Voice over lines can no longer be spammed.
[*][FIXED] An un-grabbable book in the Manor has been addressed.
[*][FIXED] Executions now play correctly for victims, even if they’re in the middle of a Third Person animation when grabbed.
[*][FIXED] Various issues with the Horse, Seagull, and Painting tasks on the Manor have been resolved.
[*][FIXED] Plugging or unplugging a headset will no longer cause the game to crash.
[*][FIXED] The roles list will now display correctly during spectate.
[*][FIXED] The number of votes required is now accurately displayed while spectating.
[*][FIXED] Various minor UI issues have been addressed for a smoother user experience.
[/list]

[b]Performance:[/b] Optimisations have been made to increase game performance.

notes.title: Update 3.3 - Introducing the Friends System
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43698514/4a7b98560e7374b91e9a0048dcdd3cdb3081a1c9.jpg[/img]

Greetings Subjects, we're thrilled to announce a number of additions and improvements this week driven by your feedback!

[h2]Introducing the Friends System[/h2]
We’ve heard you loud and clear. You can now add and invite your friends directly within the game. This new feature allows you to seamlessly connect with your friends (or enemies!) in the game, whatever platform you are all playing the game on.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43698514/8408c9b16215ad76f0894c11043b946ad84b0478.png[/img]

[h2]Final Showdown[/h2]
We are continuously evaluating the Final Showdown based on player feedback and game data. We know this feature has mixed feedback – it’s difficult to balance social deduction and action gameplay. For example, triggering the showdown only at 3 players creates entirely unplayable game states.

We are focused on developing comprehensive solutions that address all game state scenarios. Here are some of the ways we’ve improved the overall gameplay around the Final Showdown this update:

[list]
[*][b]Suspicion-Based Colour Coding:[/b] Player outlines are now colour-coded based on the suspicion system, allowing you to quickly identify friend from foe.
[*][b]Yellow Outlines:[/b] Non-player outlines and your own decoy are now outlined in yellow, making it easier to distinguish important elements during intense moments.
[*][b]Bug Fix:[/b] The Final Showdown now always triggers only when exactly four players remain, addressing an issue last patch with premature activation.
[/list]
[h2]Spectator UI Improvements[/h2]
For those who have been banished from the ritual, keeping up with the game's progression is now easier than ever. We’ve updated the spectator interface to provide a more immersive and informative viewing experience, allowing you to stay engaged with the action from the sidelines.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43698514/c6508a1b45323db1f2e66361ec310af73f9916bd.gif[/img]

[h2]Blackthorne Manor Improvements[/h2]
With the introduction of a new painting task, Blackthorne Manor has reached a pivotal milestone, marking its transition out of Early Access! The butler has also received animation improvements, UI enhancements, and new sound effects.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43698514/be39237673b2b6c941fc5751102fe1c05374a7a1.gif[/img]

[h2]Miscellaneous Improvements[/h2]
In addition to this, we've made several technical upgrades to elevate your gameplay experience:

[list]
[*][b]Unreal Engine Upgrade:[/b] We’ve transitioned to Unreal Engine 5.4.3, bringing various bug fixes and optimisations to the game.
[*][b]NVIDIA DLSS Frame Generation:[/b] PC players with 4000 series cards can now benefit from enhanced settings, offering smoother and more responsive gameplay.
[*][b]Optimisation:[/b] We have continued to optimise our maps, with some ongoing improvements rolling out with this patch.
[*][b]Character Voice Lines:[/b] We've begun to enrich the in-game experience with dynamic character voice lines, triggered by various in-game events, to deepen the immersion and storytelling.
[/list]
[h2]Balancing Adjustments[/h2]
We've made several balancing adjustments to enhance gameplay:

[list]
[*]The Vampire's bat sanity drain has been reduced from 20% to 15%, creating a fairer experience for all players.
[*]Additionally, we've reworked the player respawn logic to ensure more consistent distribution across the map.
[/list]
[h2]Patch Notes[/h2]

[h3]Features[/h3]
[list]
[*]The main menu now has a friends list - players can add and invite each other in-game.
[*]Various in-game events now trigger character voice lines to play.
[*]We’ve upgraded from Unreal Engine 5.4.1 to 5.4.3 - this primarily includes various bug fixes and optimisations.
[*]NVIDIA DLSS Frame Generation Reflex has been implemented as settings for PC players with 4000 series cards.
[*]A new painting task has been added to the Manor, with this addition, Blackthorne Manor is now out of early access.
[*]The spectator UI has had an overhaul - making it easier to track what is going on after you’ve been eliminated.
[/list]
[h3]Improvements[/h3]
[list]
[*]The butler on the manor has had his animations improved, UI improved, and sound effects implemented.
[*]Some small lighting improvements have been made on Wurgen.
[*]The wording of the ‘Silence’ mutation has been updated.
[*]Translations have been updated.
[*]Various optimisations have been made.
[*]The Vampire’s bat sanity drain has been reduced from 20% to 15%.
[*]The respawning player logic has been reworked to improve distribution.
[*]The majority of player outlines are now coloured based on the suspicion system.
[*]Non-player outlines are now yellow.
[*]Your own decoy is now outlined in yellow.
[/list]
[h3]Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*][FIXED] The Final Showdown can trigger with more than four players alive.
[*][FIXED] Players can become invincible by using the Confession Booth.
[*][FIXED] The butler can spawn in different locations for each player.
[*][FIXED] Not all nametags on the Game Summary screen can be navigated with a gamepad.

notes.title: Update 3.1 - The Confession Booth
notes.content:
Greetings Subjects,

We're excited to share the latest updates for our new map, Blackthorne Manor, as we continue to refine it during Early Access. Your invaluable feedback has been instrumental in shaping these improvements, and we can't wait for you to experience the enhancements we've made.

[h2]Introducing the Confession Booth[/h2]

With each new Ritual Site comes a unique Inspection Mechanic to work out the intentions of other Subjects. With the update of Blackthorne Manor, we're excited to introduce: The Confession Booth.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43698514/f366bc569a37d2466e2e4f5472c9f3e49995014f.png[/img]

Like all Inspection Mechanics, the Confession Booth will open when you leave the Inbetween for the first time. Two willing Subjects can enter, and their next choice may sway the outcome of the Ritual.

Once inside, you and the other Subject are secluded from the rest of the group. You will only be able to hear each other and must now make a critical decision: to Confess or Condemn!

[list]
[*] [b]Confess:[/b] If both Subjects choose to Confess, you'll learn which Team the other Subject is on.
[*] [b]Condemn:[/b] If both Subjects choose to Condemn, they will be instantly Banished from the Ritual. If one Subject chooses to Condemn and the other Subject does not, only the Condemned will be Banished from the Ritual.
[/list]
The Confession Booth is a great way to confirm someone's innocence, but beware - paranoia can cloud your judgement. So, when the time comes for you to step into the Confession Booth, will you Confess or Condemn?

[h2]Final Showdown Overhaul[/h2]

In our most recent update, we introduced the 'Final Showdown' phase to create a stronger end-game climax. Based on your feedback, we have been working on a patch to address your concerns and improve the experience.

[list]
[*]Trigger Mechanism: The Final Showdown will now begin when there are only four players left, rather than being activated by the key.
[*]Dynamic Outlines: To enrich strategy and combat, the persistent outlines will now pulse periodically, offering a more dynamic and fair experience during the showdown.
[*]Curse Adjustments: The Cursed will no longer block progress to the final Inbetween stage, except for The Chemist if they have fulfilled their Curse conditions. This adjustment ensures smoother and more balanced progression for all players.
[/list]
We will continue to monitor the live game, gather data, and listen to player feedback to determine if further adjustments are needed. Thank you for your continued feedback and support!

[h2]Task Improvements[/h2]

We've added four exciting new tasks to enhance your gameplay: Seagulls, Bells, Feed the Horse, and Coffins. These additions bring fresh challenges and opportunities for strategic play.

Furthermore, we've made improvements to existing tasks across the Manor:

[list]
[*]Various small enhancements have been made to the graveyard and cooking tasks.
[*]The alert waypoint for the butler task is now more visible, improving tracking efficiency.
[*]Updated materials for the bookcase task provide better visuals.
[*]Enhanced camera transitions for temporary tasks ensure a smoother experience.
[*]The gas lamp task boasts a new mesh and material for a revitalised look.
[*]Reactivation capability for graveyard and bookshelf tasks adds depth and replayability.
[/list]
[h2]Other Improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*]Blood altars in the great hall and courtyard have been repositioned for improved balance.
[*]Various map exploits have been fixed.
[/list]
These updates, coupled with visual enhancements throughout the Manor, aim to enrich your overall immersion and enjoyment in Blackthorne Manor.

[h2]Patch Notes[/h2]

[h3]Improvements[/h3]
[list]
[*]The Explainer video now plays when you first open the game. This can also be rewatched through the main menu's escape menu.
[*]Various UX updates have been added to the crypt to make it more intuitive to use.
[*]Characters now walk out of the crypt rather than floating, with unique animations for legendary outfits.
[*]The Chemist now gets outlined if everyone is poisoned.
[*]Alex has been given a visual glow up.
[*]Destroyable walls now have a red 'X' on them.
[*]CCTVs and Tannoys now spark when broken.
[*]The alert for your infected partner becoming soulbound has been improved.

notes.title: Minor Update — Season 2
notes.content:
Subjects,

Your voices have been heard over the last few days, and we've swiftly implemented updates to fix some key issues. Our latest patch is now live, here's what has changed:

[b]Gameplay[/b]
[list]
[*] [FIXED] Players are able to access unintended areas of the map whilst vaulting.
[*] [FIXED] Players can get stuck after using the Suspicion Wheel. This fix was released earlier this week.
[*] [FIXED] Players assigned the Seer role don't earn XP for using their role, or progress the Seer's Accolade. This fix was released earlier this week.
[/list]
[b]Input[/b]
[list]
[*] Added a 'Suspicion Wheel Behaviour' setting for gamepad users to control how using the Suspicion Wheel works. By default this is now set to 'Toggle'.
[*] The 'Hold Delay' setting is now forced to be >= 50ms. This value is what controls when some gameplay actions switch from being considered a toggle to a hold (e.g. the Role Ability wheel), or when the 'Ping' input instead opens the Quick Chat wheel. Having a value near 0ms was the cause for some players being unable to report Blood Altars.
[/list]
[b]Tech[/b]
[list]
[*] Players will now perform a connection test to the game server before beginning the 'role reveal' cinematic. If another player fails to connect you will seamlessly re-enter the queue, whilst they will be de-queued and informed that they failed to connect.
[*] The anti-dodging system has been updated. Previously players would receive dodge timers, scaling based on number of dodges, but it was a hidden system and it behaved as if you were in queue for longer. With this update you will now be told when a penalty has been given to you for dodging. Alongside this, we've roughly doubled the timeouts granted for dodging and have increased the time before the scaling aspect resets.
[*] The loading screen's timeout has been increased by 15 seconds for players playing in custom lobbies. This should help ensure those playing with friends across the world, or with notably slower hardware, can get into games easier.
[*] Several frequent crashes have been patched either earlier this week, or with this update. If you're still frequently experiencing crashes, and are playing on a PC, we'd recommend updating your graphics drivers.
[*] [FIXED] Xbox players can be left unable to interact with the menu after opening an Xbox interface, such as the one for inviting a friend.
[/list]

Thank you for your continued feedback and support!

See you in the ritual!

notes.title: The Midseason Update: Introducing The Seer
notes.content:
Greetings Subjects!

We are pleased to announce the release of our Midseason Update, introducing a range of new features, improvements, and updates.

Here’s what’s new:

[b]Introducing A Brand New Innocent Role - The Seer[/b]
Get ready to redefine your strategy with our brand new role - The Seer! The Seer brings a unique edge to the innocent team by allowing you to catch someone transforming into Terror or confirm a teammate's innocence, building crucial trust. The Seer's ability to disrupt ghost forms provides vital intel, giving your team a strategic advantage. Plus, enjoy the brand new animations and visual effects that make identifying opponents easier and more exciting. Harness the Seer's power and lead your team to victory!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43698514/e52214ddcdd7c8b15f1d59680b2d26a74b0734ce.gif[/img]

[b]Intro Sequence & Visual Updates[/b]
This update we have made some visual improvements driven by our commitment to creating a more immersive and visually appealing game world, ensuring that every moment you spend in Deceit feels vibrant and engaging. We've also addressed several map exploits in both Millhaven and Wurgen, ensuring that your gameplay experience remains seamless and fair.

We’ve revamped the intro sequence to enhance your immersion from the moment you start the game.

[previewyoutube=DUQegT8lLUY;full][/previewyoutube]

In addition, you’ll see some improvements have been made to some in-game ritualistic elements:
[list]
[*] The peddler and escape doors are now adorned with brand new runes
[*] The Blood Altars have been given a makeover, and are now much more detailed and ominous 
[*] The Banishing Ritual has been overhauled with brand new effects
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43698514/58574ddc5a494d7054464a95208d67fd0f596ee8.gif[/img]

[b]Pacing and Scale Tweaks[/b]
We’ve made some changes to the player movement to improve how it feels to shoot and traverse the map. This is an ongoing process, so we’ll continue to read feedback and make adjustments as needed.

[list]
[*] 10% Faster Sprints: Both Humans and Terrors can now sprint 10% faster, intensifying the pace of your encounters.
[*] Adjusted (De)acceleration for Humans: We've refined the (de)acceleration mechanics to improve precision when hitting players that are rapidly turning around.
[*] Increased Gravity: We’ve increased gravity to make jumping snappier, enhancing overall movement responsiveness.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43698514/0b5ed42b71cf44f5b67fb43190dfc7fefabd9ad4.gif[/img]

[b]In-Game Player Reporting[/b]
In response to concerns about toxicity, we're actively enhancing our community experience. Previously, reporting players mid-game wasn't an option. Now, with this update, you can open the game menu and report someone instantly. This proactive approach empowers you to address issues as they occur, fostering a fair and respectful environment. But our efforts don't end there. We're dedicated to ongoing improvements, which include refining our guidelines, expanding the moderation team, and enhancing reporting tools. Ensuring a positive and inclusive gaming experience for all remains one of our top priorities.

[b]Voting System Overhaul[/b]
We've replaced the remote voting system with a brand new Suspicion Wheel to streamline the process and make it easier to understand for new players and viewers.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43698514/bf60da57c073ea844c7ce117ce63e5c298ab216b.gif[/img]

Interacting through an interface diminished the essential face-to-face interactions, and the overuse of the “Remote Voting” wheel for both voting and role abilities led to excessive interface interactions, which new players found quite unintuitive. Additionally, players often voted randomly when someone was downed using the radial wheel, which felt less meaningful. By voting in person, the process becomes clearer and more engaging.

In place of “Remote Voting” you can now mark players as “suspicious”, which will add a helpful marker to their nametag.

[b]You Asked, We Listened[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Button Remapping for Gamepads:[/b] You can now - finally! - fully customise your gamepad controls, allowing for a more personalised and comfortable gaming experience.
[*] [b]Heat Goggles Tweak: [/b]In response to your feedback, we've made adjustments to the heat goggles visuals to enhance clarity and usability. This change comes as a response to concerns about the strength of these visuals when pushed to their limit.
[/list]
[b]Infrastructure Improvements[/b]
[b]Server Migration:[/b] We’ve been working hard to ensure that we reduce the number of cancelled games, improve latency and reduce connection issues. This is an ongoing process as we are trialling numerous different server locations this month. We appreciate your patience, and are confident that you will notice improvements over the course of this month.

[b]Engine Upgrade:[/b] We’ve upgraded our engine version to UE 5.4.1 to enhance performance and introduce new capabilities. As part of this upgrade, we’ve temporarily removed DLSS and FSR support (on PC), as they’re still being updated. We will release a patch to enable these as soon as possible, but in the meantime we’re confident you’ll still see improved performance from the previous patch. For users needing extra performance, we recommend using TSAA and lowering the resolution scaling. These adjustments should automatically apply to other graphics settings by default, but if you had manually enabled DLSS or FSR, you may need to update your settings.

[b]Sneak Peek: Season 3[/b]
We’re already looking ahead to Season 3, and we’re excited to give you a sneak peek! Get ready for the Manor, a new map featuring a chilling new terror, an intriguing new role, and a brand-new item. Stay tuned for more details as we get closer to Season 3!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43698514/239282c4f8555a770d3dfd83ca399df4ec91cca2.jpg[/img]

Thank you for your continued support and feedback. We can’t wait to see how you leverage The Seer and enjoy all the enhancements in this midseason update. Jump in, explore the new features, and see you in the ritual!

The Deceit Team

--

[b]Patch Notes[/b]

[b]Animation[/b]
[list]
[*] Each character now has a unique animation when first spawning into the game.
[*] [FIXED] The head of a downed player will rotate based on where they’re looking.
[*] [FIXED] Feminine characters have larger than intended heads in-game. This can cause clipping with cosmetics that cover their faces.
[/list]

[list]
[*] Updated the visual of the Blood Altars.
[*] Updated the visual of banishing rituals, used when voting players out of the game.
[*] Updated both Millhaven & Wurgen to address several map exploits, commonly leading to players being inaccessible to the Terrors.
[/list]

[b]Audio[/b]
[list]
[*] Added audio to several emotes.
[*] Updated the effects applied in the Inbetween to increase the reverb.
[*] Adjusted the volume of several sounds, including the Final Showdown music, tasks and executions.
[*] Added audio for transforming into and out of the Werewolf Terror.
[*] [FIXED] The Dialogue volume slider doesn’t affect the Game Master’s VO.
[*] [FIXED] The sound for the Wolf AI spawning is played in 2D.
[*] [FIXED] Beck plays Hans’ scream when being executed by a Terror.
[*] [FIXED] Terror execution sounds, and passive idle sounds, can play shortly after returning to Reality.
[/list]

[b]Gameplay[/b]
[list]
[*] Reporting Blood Altars is now done via the Pinging system rather than an interaction.
[*] Updated the Heat Goggles, primarily to help address how dominant they can be when pushed to their limit:
[list] [list]
[*] Revealed players will no longer have a black silhouette behind the red ‘haze’, revealing extra animation information.
[*] Added a fade to/from black when going in/out of the view.
[*] Once the Heat Goggle view is active, there is a brief delay before players are revealed.
[*] You can no longer re-equip the Heat Goggles as you’re unequipping them.
[*] Slowed down the battery drain tick rate from 0.1s to 0.25s. This results in the minimum drain being higher than before.
[*] [FIXED] After using the Heat Goggles your hand is left as if it’s holding the Heat Goggles.
[*] [FIXED] Very infrequently it’s possible for the Heat Goggles to contain to drain your charge despite not being active.
[/list] [/list]
[*] Increased the Inquisitor’s effect duration from 4 to 5 seconds.
[*] The world will now desaturate based on the number of votes cast on you.
[*] Adjusted the camera offsets used both when you’re downed, and when you’re emoting, so that they’re centered around your character.
[*] [FIXED] Wurgen’s 4 digit code system can break after the Generator has been destroyed, causing valid codes to be rejected.
[*] [FIXED] After an execution, players with high latency can occasionally see the human form of the Terror involved in the execution.
[*] [FIXED] The Chemist’s poison fails to activate if they use their last poison charge whilst transitioning into the Inbetween.
[*] [FIXED] The human form of a player can be briefly revealed after using the Invisibility Medallion or transforming into a Terror.
[*] [FIXED] A blank character mesh can be briefly shown when a player switches items in the Inbetween.
[*] [FIXED] When spectating, other players aren’t correctly turned into their ghost form.
[*] [FIXED] The Muzzle’s “Zip It” accolade doesn’t progress if you use the Muzzle on a Cursed Subject.
[*] [FIXED] When using the custom setting to spawn with a Pistol, players using Gamepads are unable to equip items.
[*] [FIXED] You can shoot through Wurgen’s Inspection Vat doors whilst inside of them. 
[/list]

[b]Input[/b]

[*] Added support for changing button mappings on Gamepads.

[/list]

[b]Progression[/b]
[list]

[/list]

[b]UI[/b]

[*] Players being voted on will now be waypointed to you, showing their current vote status and distance.
[*] Updated the UI shown when voting players out of the game. Most notably the interaction prompt is now separate to the vote status.
[*] Updated how 3D UI is rendered so that it is consistent across different maps and lighting setups.
[*] Added a UI element to the bottom left to indicate when the Generator is destroyed.
[*] Reduced the delay before the voting UI appears above a downed player.
[*] The Escape Door now displays the win conditions for each team when you look at it.
[*] Infected players will now see the global popup informing them that a player has been banished after executing a Subject.
[*] Added a link to our Medium webpage on the Menu, allowing players to view the latest patch notes through the game.
[*] [FIXED] Waypoints don’t correctly show directional arrows when the target is off screen.
[/list]

notes.title: Season 2 - Midsummer Nightmare
notes.content:
Prepare to dive into Midsummer Nightmare as Season 2 commences! We've addressed over 100 bugs and reviewed over 70 suggestions from our dedicated community. Your feedback has been crucial in shaping our roadmap, and we're grateful for your ongoing help in enhancing the game. Additionally, Season 1 has now concluded, and you can find its cosmetics available in the crypt. 
Since our console launch, our player base has steadily grown, thanks to the unwavering support of our community. With over 6,000 concurrent players and consistent week-on-week growth, we deeply appreciate your continued support!

Here's what awaits you in Season 2 - Midsummer Nightmare:

[b]New Emotes and Loading Screens [/b]

Check out the new emotes system and custom loading screens, included in the season pass! Express yourself with a range of gestures. The custom loading screens offer tantalising teasers of the game's world, setting the stage for thrilling challenges ahead.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43698514/00c6b5ad8199267d83d9913d527a76c7cde5f21d.gif[/img]
[b]Fresh Cosmetics and Season Pass[/b]

Get ready to upgrade your arsenal with our brand-new Season Pass, featuring the sleek Synthwave Pistol skin and dive into the depths of fear with the electrifying Aqua Werewolf Terror. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43698514/2c1fb6aef55e166998d1354a2ddaaaec2b7957a7.gif[/img]

Discover our newest bundle, offering 30,000 Season XP, access to the Season Pass, and 3 Crypt keys, all for the price of 2000 shillings compared to the 900 tokens for just the pass. Plus, don't miss the exclusive Fireball Medallion, available for purchase only in the store! And remember, you can always upgrade from the base pass to the bundle for added benefits. 

The Chocolate Bunny Outfit is currently unavailable for purchase in the store since Season 1 has concluded; while it's not accessible in the crypt either, there's a possibility it may be reintroduced to the store for a limited time at a later date. To purchase the Season 2 Pass or bundle, head over to the new shop tab.

Here's a quick rundown of the changes we've made to the rarity chance distribution within the crypt:

Common: Decreased from 60% to 40%
Uncommon: Slightly reduced from 30% to 25%
Rare: A significant increase from 12.5% to 20%
Legendary: A substantial boost from 2.5% to 10%

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43698514/a3f5c3b14a1c5c7f3d83cedc6755b365e8c00202.gif[/img]

[b]You Asked, We Listened[/b]

Here are some of the key features we’ve dropped into game following [b]YOUR [/b] feedback:

[list]
[*] Express Yourself: A brand-new 'Emote' system! Customise your Emote Wheel in the menu to quickly unleash your emotions in-game. Whether you're on KBM, just hit 'C', or on controller, tap D-Pad Right to bring your chosen emote to life! 
[*] Customise Your Perspective: Take control with new settings allowing you to adjust the base field of view! Tailor your view to suit your playstyle and immerse yourself fully in the heart-pounding action of ritual.
[*] Seamless Communication: Stay connected with continuous voice chat now available in-game! Engage in uninterrupted conversations with other players as you navigate the ritual. Don't worry, if you prefer Push To Talk, simply adjust your settings in the Audio menu. 
[*] Curse of the Chemist: Increased Poison Capacity: Hold up to 2 poison stacks for heightened chaos. Progress towards the Inbetween is halted once all players are poisoned, ensuring a fair chance to thwart the Chemist.
[*]Evolution of the Inquisitor: Reveal all Weak Points and their status, amplifying strategic advantage. Weak Point details now display directly, streamlining gameplay efficiency.
[/list]
Expect plenty of new additions, like a brand-new role, in our upcoming mid-season update. Additionally, our live roadmap reveals what's on the horizon, including The Vespal and a new map, 'The Manor’.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43698514/8e2f697ffa2cea02c7c8f7216333ba1f99661b40.png[/img]
See you in the ritual,

The Deceit Team

--

[b]Patch Notes[/b]

[b]Animation[/b]
[list]
[*] Human characters will now play a face animation whilst using voice chat. There is also now an idle face animation.
[*] [FIXED] Wurgen’s Wolf Task doesn’t play a looping idle animation.
[/list]
[b]Art[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed several map exploits on both Millhaven & Wurgen.
[*] Updated the Task guide characters on Wurgen to better fit their associated Tasks.
[*] Updated the model used for Crypt Keys.
[*] Updated the character’s face meshes to improve their visuals especially in higher quality LODs.
[*] Updated the lighting on Wurgen. This includes making the lights change when the Generator has been destroyed.
[*] Updated Wurgen’s keypad material.
[*] Updated the Menu visuals for Season 2.
[*] [FIXED] Some character cosmetics briefly ‘explode’ when previewed on lower graphics settings.
[/list]
[b]Audio[/b]
[list]
[*] Added support for using continuous voice chat in-game. This is the default setting however you can revert back to using Push To Talk in the Audio settings.
[*] You can now continue to talk with your party during the game found sequence in the Menu.
[*] The ‘Background Audio’ setting is now defaulted to being on, meaning that sound will play even if the game isn’t focused when playing on PC. You can disable this again in the Audio settings.
[*] Optimised several sound effects to reduce the likelihood, and severity, of the ‘static’ sounding audio issue that players on lower spec PCs experience. There’s still more work to be done for this issue, but players should notice a notable improvement.
[*] Updated proximity voice chat’s attenuation configuration.
[*] The sound effect used for previewing a cosmetic will now only be played when you equip that cosmetic.
[*] Added a sound effect for when Wurgen’s Generator has been destroyed.
[*] Added a sound effect for using a Crypt Key.
[*] Added a sound effect for interacting with the Showers Task.
[*] Added a sound effect for when the Handcuffs are removed from a player.

[*] Improved the fading out of the Menu music as you enter a game.
[*] Added audio to the Heat Goggles and Return Pad first time equip animations.

The ‘Chemist’ Curse has been updated:
[*] You can now hold up to 2 poison stacks. You still start with 1, and the time to recharge a stack is the same.
[*] Once everyone has been poisoned the progress to the Inbetween is paused. This means there’s always the same amount of time to find, and eliminate, the Chemist before they escape the Ritual.

The ‘Inquisitor’ Human role has been updated:
[*] Activating the ability will now reveal all Weak Points on the map, displaying if they’re active or not. You can still see player footprints during the ability.

[b]Input[/b]

[/list]
[b]Tech[/b]
[list]
[*] Added a setting for window behavior on PC when a game has been found. You can configure the game window to be brought to the front, flash or disable this system all together. The default is for the game window to be brought to the front of your other windows.
[*] Various CPU and GPU performance optimisations have been made across the board.
[*] Adjusted the level load timeout to return to the Menu faster if someone fails to connect.
[*] Updated what is loaded before you progress past the ‘Start Screen’. This will reduce the likelihood of hitching as you enter the Menu.
[*] Optimised how game servers are allocated to reduce time spent in queue when more players are online.
[*] Identified and fixed some stability issues with our backend services.
[/list]
[b]Translations & Localization[/b]
[list]
[*] Several translations have been updated.
[/list]
[b]UI[/b]
[list]
[*] You can now select a Loading Screen image to be used when you enter games.
[*] You can now rotate the cosmetics that you’re previewing in the Collection, Season and Crypt screens.
[*] Added a separate ‘Store’ tab to the Menu.
[*] [FIXED] Nametags display that players are level 0 when their level data hasn’t been loaded.
[*] [FIXED] The Game Found UI can show incorrect role information after a game has been canceled.

notes.title: Season 1 - Mid-season Update
notes.content:
With our inaugural season in full swing - the Game Master is back with a mid-season update full of quality of life improvements and bug fixes to keep the lies flowing and backstabbing knives sharp. This week we’ve fully opened the doors to our new PlayStation and Xbox friends - who we’d like to give a special shout out to for providing their invaluable feedback and suggestions in our [url=https://discord.gg/deceit]Discord[/url] that has helped shape this update.

As for what you can expect next - our second season ‘Midsummer Nightmare’ begins on May 2nd for which we will soon be sharing details on the exciting new content we are working on.

Thank you for your continued support - and we look forward to seeing you in game!

The Deceit Team

notes.title: Season 1 - Humble Beginnings
notes.content:
Our first Season, Humble Beginnings, starts now! As you work your way through the Season, you’ll be able to collect 42 new skins for Subjects, Terrors and items, as well as Crypt keys for additional rewards along the way as you earn XP. Progressing from Uncommon to Legendary Skins, you’ll have a range of new bling to flaunt as you deceive and deduce.

A number of these rewards are part of the Premium pass, which you can purchase for 500 Shillings on the Season tab.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43698514/425851be9dfad555a7bf71e258b62d0ca5425190.png[/img]
[h2]The Crypt [/h2]
Speaking of Crypt Keys, the Crypt is open for business! The Crypt will be the go-to place to unlock Subject, Terror, and Item skins, including ones you may have missed out on in previous events.
Favour that existing players had earned before we made the move to XP will see that Favour exchanged for Crypt Keys! All unspent favour, plus the value of any bought plinths will be converted automatically as follows:
[list]
[*] 10k+ favour -> 1 Crypt Key
[*] 100k+ favour -> 2 Crypt Keys
[*] 200k+ favour -> 3 Crypt Keys
[*] 300k+ favour -> 4 Crypt Keys
[*] …and so on.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43698514/ef6b1a821cdfc631a880f3a763404972cf50c985.png[/img]
[h2]Are you ready to Ascend?[/h2]
[b]Titles [/b]have arrived - they unlock automatically as you level up. If you’ve already passed the rank requirement, you will find your unlocked titles waiting for you after you’ve played a game following this update. Each Accolade has a unique title, like [i]‘Chameleon’[/i] for using your Mimic role and going on to win the Ritual, or [i]‘Killjoy’[/i] for destroying items like traps or motion sensors. To equip them, head to the Ascension tab to show off to your party and fellow players in the end of game screen. 

We’ve been adjusting the requirements for existing Accolades, lowering the requirements on 18 Accolades that were out of line with our intended progression rate. None of your progress was lost as a result of this change!

We also reduced the total Accolade point requirement for hitting each Ascension rank to ensure you feel that you’re progressing faster. None of your progress has been lost and if you’ve gone up a rank from this you will automatically equip your new Implant after playing a game. 

[h2]Bringing clarity to the confusion[/h2]
Like the relationship between Selena and Justin, Deceit 2 can feel complicated to the new player. We have been improving existing SFX and UI, and adding new elements to make things clearer for new players too. 

Running around in the mayhem of Millhaven or the weirdness of Wurgen, you may not immediately spot souls ready to be released back to the Peddler. We’ve implemented new figures to aid direction, and draw you to these souls. Once released, souls will enter the Implant on your hand with a new animation, and are transferred straight to the Peddler.

We’re in the process of reworking our in-game Glossary to make it more useful. We’ll continue to work on onboarding to make the game quicker to get to grips with.

Last but not least, we’ve been hard at work to improve our infrastructure and systems so that players can more reliably connect to games. We’ve made notable improvements around ensuring players that can’t connect to our servers don’t get put into the game queue, and progress on cancelling games as soon as possible if a player fails to connect. We’ll be continuing to work on this in the coming weeks. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43698514/72773d6bf7bf8b799644e7480f6c5341b3469fec.jpg[/img]

As we gear up for the full console launch next week, don't forget to wishlist Deceit 2 on [url=https://store.playstation.com/en-gb/concept/10007312]PlayStation 5[/url] and [url=https://www.xbox.com/en-GB/games/store/deceit-2/9n9xndqb8cl1?utm_source=Deceit2&utm_medium=Xbox&utm_campaign=F2P]Xbox Series X|S[/url] – and feel free to share the news with your friends. 

Your feedback is invaluable to us, and it's crucial for us to keep improving—even as we gear up for the console launch next week. Please keep it coming!

The Deceit Team

notes.title: Patch Notes - Week 1
notes.content:
Thank you to everyone who has jumped into the Ritual of Deceit 2 since we went Free to Play on 13th March! It’s so exciting to see so many of you exploring the depths of the Game Master’s depravity, and sharing your thoughts and ideas on how we can continue to refine the game. 

Today’s update comes with a plethora of fixes and small additions based on your feedback since the F2P launch - we will be hard at work collating your further feedback to address over the coming weeks.

As for what is upcoming, you can check out our post on [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2064870/view/4119177000549059476]Titles and The Crypt[/url] for some information as to what will be in our next update ahead of our console launch on April 3rd.

We look forward to seeing you deceive and manipulate, and ascend the Ritual of Deceit!
